{"parentUuid":"6f6ac93f-c4e2-496f-bea8-86e016fa177b","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_0169EprCpR8qgax2nNGj8oRW","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Th6Js4jHARjoAWgetHM6NV","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\.claude\\skills\\postgres-pgvector\\SKILL.md","content":"---\nname: postgres-pgvector\ndescription: Design Postgres schemas with pgvector and TimescaleDB for StockForge. Use when creating migrations, designing tables, writing queries. Covers vector embeddings for semantic search on Vietnamese text, time-series for price/sentiment data, JSONB vs structured columns.\nallowed-tools: [Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Edit, Write]\n---\n\n# Skill: Postgres + pgvector + TimescaleDB\n\n## Purpose\n\nConsistent schema patterns leveraging Postgres 16 extensions for Vietnamese stock market data. Encodes structural-vs-JSONB rules, point-in-time integrity for fundamentals (I-S2), and pgvector indexing for Vietnamese semantic search.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- Authoring a new migration in `apps/api/migrations/`\n- Designing an aggregate persistence schema\n- Choosing between JSONB and structured columns\n- Adding semantic search via embeddings\n- Modeling time-series (prices, sentiment, KOL recommendation streams)\n\n## When NOT to Use\n\n- Pure domain layer design — see `ddd-tactical-patterns` first; persistence is downstream\n- Phase 1 (Streamlit-direct) prototyping — defer migration discipline; just write SQLite or pickled CSV\n- Frontend / dashboard schemas — N/A\n\n## Extensions\n\n```sql\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS \"uuid-ossp\";    -- UUID generation\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS \"pg_trgm\";      -- Fuzzy text search (Vietnamese)\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS \"vector\";       -- pgvector for embeddings\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS \"timescaledb\";  -- Time-series (prices, sentiment)\n```\n\n## Decision Rules\n\n### Structured column vs JSONB\n\n| Use **structured** when | Use **JSONB** when |\n|---|---|\n| Field is queried in WHERE | Schema differs per row |\n| Field is indexed | Archive / audit data |\n| Field has CHECK / NOT NULL / FK | Document returned together |\n| Field is critical business state (ticker, dates, amounts) | No indexed sub-field access needed |\n\nHard rule: ticker, dates, status, amounts → ALWAYS structured. Never JSONB.\n\n### Time-series vs row table\n\n- High-cardinality time-stamped (prices, volumes, sentiment, foreign flow) → TimescaleDB hypertable\n- Aggregates / one-shot per period (financial statements) → regular table with `period_end + filing_date`\n- Domain events → regular table with `sequence_num BIGSERIAL` for ordered replay\n\n### Vector index\n\n- pgvector cosine similarity → HNSW (`m=16, ef_construction=64`)\n- Embedding dimension fixed per model_version; never change without migration\n\n## Process — designing a new table\n\n1. **Identify aggregate boundary** (per `ddd-tactical-patterns`). One table per aggregate root; child tables FK back.\n2. **List queryable fields** — these become structured columns with appropriate indexes.\n3. **List archival/audit fields** — these go in JSONB.\n4. **Add point-in-time fields** if data describes a past period: `period_end DATE` + `filing_date DATE` (I-S2 requirement — backtests filter on `filing_date <= ...`).\n5. **Add temporal audit**: `created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()`, `updated_at`, `version INT` for optimistic locking on aggregate roots.\n6. **Add source attribution** if multi-provider: `source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('vnstock','fiinpro','manual'))`. Required for I-S2 disagreement surfacing.\n7. **Index queryable WHERE columns + ORDER BY ranges**; do NOT index every column.\n8. **Wrap in BEGIN/COMMIT** in migration; one logical change per file; test up + down.\n\nSee `references/schema-patterns.md` for full SQL templates (aggregate root, point-in-time, event log, pgvector, hypertable, continuous aggregate).\n\n## Anti-Patterns\n\n**Don't**:\n- Put business logic in triggers — use application layer\n- `SELECT *` in production code — explicit column list always\n- Skip migration for \"quick schema change\" — every schema change is a migration\n- Index everything \"just in case\" — slows writes\n- Store timestamps without TZ — always TIMESTAMPTZ\n- Use JSONB for ticker / dates / status / amounts — they're queryable\n- Query fundamentals without `filing_date` filter in backtest (I-S2 violation)\n- String-interpolate user input into SQL (injection)\n\n**Do**:\n- Structured columns for queryable fields; JSONB for flexible/archival\n- HNSW index for pgvector cosine similarity\n- Prepared statements / parameterized queries always (asyncpg `$1`)\n- Transactions for multi-statement logic\n- `version` column for optimistic locking on aggregates\n- TIMESTAMPTZ for all timestamps\n\n## Validation Pre-Conditions\n\n- Migration file matches `apps/api/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_description.sql`\n- Migration is idempotent (`IF NOT EXISTS` on extensions, indexes)\n- Every fundamental-data table has BOTH `period_end` AND `filing_date`\n- Every multi-provider table has `source` CHECK constraint\n- Every embedding table has `model_version` column\n\n## Smoke Test\n\nFor a sample task — \"design table for KOL recommendation tracking\":\n\nExpected output shape:\n- One aggregate root `kol_recommendations` table with structured: id, kol_id, ticker, action ('buy'|'sell'|'hold'), recommended_at TIMESTAMPTZ, source URL, period of validity\n- JSONB for: original_post_text, extraction_metadata\n- Index: `(kol_id, recommended_at DESC)` + `(ticker, recommended_at DESC)`\n- Point-in-time: `recommended_at` (when the rec was published) + `extracted_at` (when our pipeline saw it)\n\nIf the proposal includes both audit timestamps + structured queryable fields + JSONB only for free-form text → skill is functional.\n\n## See Also\n\n- `references/schema-patterns.md` — full SQL templates (aggregate, point-in-time, event log, pgvector, TimescaleDB)\n- `ddd-tactical-patterns` SKILL.md — aggregates that map to these tables\n- `fastapi-module` SKILL.md — repositories accessing these tables (Phase 2+)\n- `agent-workspace/constitution/invariants.md` § I-S2 — citation + as-of date requirement\n- `PROJECT_CHARTER.md` § Technical Foundation — stack rationale\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":431,"cache_read_input_tokens":122520,"output_tokens":5779,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":431,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":5779,"cache_read_input_tokens":122520,"cache_creation_input_tokens":431,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":431},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CaYE3YFQWv7skL4BBZkcS","type":"assistant","uuid":"fd509c55-1fb3-4c98-9ba2-98d31fc34d03","timestamp":"2026-04-29T14:32:36.789Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"1691a5a8-8de7-439a-834f-1e05173f2431","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

TimescaleDB for StockForge. Use when creating migrations, designing tables, writing queries. Covers vector embeddings for semantic search on Vietnamese text, time-series for price/sentiment data, JSONB vs structured columns.\n---\n\n# Skill: Postgres + pgvector + TimescaleDB\n\n## Purpose\n\nConsistent schema patterns leveraging Postgres 16 extensions for Vietnamese stock market data.\n\n## Extensions Used\n\n```sql\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS \"uuid-ossp\";    -- UUID generation\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS \"pg_trgm\";      -- Fuzzy text search (Vietnamese)\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS \"vector\";       -- pgvector for embeddings\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS \"timescaledb\";  -- Time-series (prices, sentiment)\n```\n\n## Table Design Patterns\n\n### Aggregate Root Table\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE theses (\n  -- Identity\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),\n  \n  -- References\n  ticker TEXT NOT NULL,\n  user_id UUID NOT NULL,\n  \n  -- State\n  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'active', 'closed')),\n  \n  -- Business content (JSONB for flexible structure)\n  bull_case JSONB NOT NULL,\n  bear_case JSONB NOT NULL,\n  catalysts JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',\n  \n  -- Calibration\n  confidence_score NUMERIC(4,3) CHECK (confidence_score BETWEEN 0 AND 1),\n  hit_rate_basis INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- N past theses of this type\n  \n  -- Temporal\n  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),\n  submitted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,\n  closed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,\n  \n  -- Audit\n  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),\n  version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1  -- optimistic locking\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX idx_theses_ticker ON theses(ticker, created_at DESC);\nCREATE INDEX idx_theses_status ON theses(status) WHERE status IN ('draft', 'active');\n```\n\n### Point-in-Time Integrity (Fundamentals)\n\nEvery fundamental data row MUST have both dates:\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE financial_statements (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),\n  ticker TEXT NOT NULL,\n  \n  -- CRITICAL: point-in-time integrity (I-S2)\n  period_end DATE NOT NULL,      -- what period this covers\n  filing_date DATE NOT NULL,     -- when it became public knowledge\n  \n  -- Financials (all in VND million)\n  revenue BIGINT,\n  net_income BIGINT,\n  total_assets BIGINT,\n  total_equity BIGINT,\n  \n  -- Source\n  source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('vnstock', 'fiinpro', 'manual')),\n  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),\n  \n  UNIQUE(ticker, period_end, filing_date, source)\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX idx_financial_ticker_period ON financial_statements(ticker, filing_date DESC, period_end DESC);\n```\n\nBacktest query MUST use filing_date filter:\n```sql\n-- CORRECT: filters by when data was known (avoids look-ahead bias)\nSELECT * FROM financial_statements\nWHERE ticker = 'VCB'\n  AND filing_date <= '2024-03-31'::date\nORDER BY period_end DESC\nLIMIT 1;\n\n-- WRONG: would introduce look-ahead bias in backtest\n-- SELECT * FROM financial_statements WHERE ticker = 'VCB' ORDER BY period_end DESC LIMIT 1;\n```\n\n### Event Log Table\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE domain_events (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),\n  aggregate_id UUID NOT NULL,\n  aggregate_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  event_version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n  payload JSONB NOT NULL,\n  occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),\n  published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,\n  sequence_num BIGSERIAL NOT NULL\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX idx_events_aggregate ON domain_events(aggregate_type, aggregate_id, occurred_at);\nCREATE INDEX idx_events_unpublished ON domain_events(occurred_at) WHERE published_at IS NULL;\n```\n\n## pgvector for Semantic Search (Vietnamese)\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE article_embeddings (\n  article_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES news_articles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  embedding vector(1536) NOT NULL,  -- OpenAI text-embedding-3-small\n  model_version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text-embedding-3-small',\n  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()\n);\n\n-- HNSW index for cosine similarity search\nCREATE INDEX idx_article_embeddings_hnsw ON article_embeddings \n  USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops)\n  WITH (m = 16, ef_construction = 64);\n```\n\nSemantic search query:\n```sql\nSELECT \n  ae.article_id,\n  1 - (ae.embedding <=> $1::vector) AS similarity\nFROM article_embeddings ae\nWHERE 1 - (ae.embedding <=> $1::vector) > 0.85\nORDER BY ae.embedding <=> $1::vector\nLIMIT 10;\n```\n\n## TimescaleDB for Price/Sentiment Time-Series\n\n```sql\n-- Market data hypertable\nCREATE TABLE market_bars (\n  time TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,\n  ticker TEXT NOT NULL,\n  open NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,\n  high NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,\n  low NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,\n  close NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,\n  volume BIGINT NOT NULL,\n  foreign_buy_volume BIGINT,\n  foreign_sell_volume BIGINT\n);\n\nSELECT create_hypertable('market_bars', 'time');\n\nCREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_market_bars_ticker_time ON market_bars(ticker, time DESC);\n\n-- Continuous aggregate for daily OHLCV\nCREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW market_bars_daily\nWITH (timescaledb.continuous) AS\nSELECT\n  time_bucket('1 day', time) AS day,\n  ticker,\n  FIRST(open, time) AS open,\n  MAX(high) AS high,\n  MIN(low) AS low,\n  LAST(close, time) AS close,\n  SUM(volume) AS volume\nFROM market_bars\nGROUP BY day, ticker;\n```\n\n## JSONB vs Structured Columns\n\n**Use structured columns when**:\n- Field is queried in WHERE clauses\n- Field is indexed\n- Field has constraints (CHECK, NOT NULL, FK)\n- Field is critical business state (ticker, dates, amounts)\n\n**Use JSONB when**:\n- Flexible schema (different shapes per row)\n- Archive / audit data\n- Full document is usually returned together\n- No indexed access needed on sub-fields\n\n## Migration Conventions\n\n### File Naming\n`apps/api/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_description.sql`\n\nExample: `20260420100000_create_theses_table.sql`\n\n### Structure\n```sql\n-- Up migration\nBEGIN;\n\nCREATE TABLE theses (/* ... */);\nCREATE INDEX /* ... */;\n\nCOMMIT;\n\n-- Down migration (in comment or separate file)\n-- BEGIN;\n-- DROP TABLE theses;\n-- COMMIT;\n```\n\n### Rules\n- Always wrap in BEGIN/COMMIT\n- Idempotent where possible (`IF NOT EXISTS`)\n- No data manipulation in schema migrations (use separate data migration)\n- Test up and down\n- One logical change per migration\n\n## Query Patterns\n\n### With explicit column list\n```python\n# Good\nrows = await db.fetch(\"\"\"\n    SELECT id, status, created_at\n    FROM theses\n    WHERE ticker = $1 AND status = 'active'\n    ORDER BY created_at DESC\n\"\"\", ticker)\n\n# Bad — SELECT *\n# rows = await db.fetch(\"SELECT * FROM theses WHERE ...\")\n```\n\n### Prepared statements (asyncpg)\n```python\n# Use parameterized queries always\nstmt = await conn.prepare(\"SELECT * FROM theses WHERE id = $1\")\nrow = await stmt.fetchrow(thesis_id)\n\n# Never string interpolation\n# await conn.fetch(f\"SELECT * FROM theses WHERE id = '{thesis_id}'\")  # SQL INJECTION\n```\n\n## Anti-Patterns\n\n**Don't**:\n- Put business logic in triggers (use application)\n- Use `SELECT *` in production code\n- Skip migrations for \"quick schema change\"\n- Index everything \"just in case\" (slows writes)\n- Store timestamps without TZ (always use TIMESTAMPTZ)\n- Use JSONB for queryable fields (ticker, dates, status)\n- Query fundamental data without filing_date filter in backtest paths (I-S2 violation)\n\n**Do**:\n- Structured columns for queryable fields\n- JSONB for flexible/archival metadata\n- HNSW index for pgvector\n- Prepared statements always\n- Transactions for multi-statement logic\n- Version tracking with `version` column for optimistic locking\n- TIMESTAMPTZ for all timestamps\n\n## Related\n\n- `ddd-tactical-patterns` — aggregates mapped to these tables\n- `fastapi-module` — repositories accessing these tables (Phase 2+)\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"fd509c55-1fb3-4c98-9ba2-98d31fc34d03","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"1691a5a8-8de7-439a-834f-1e05173f2431","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

dates:\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE financial_statements (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),\n  ticker TEXT NOT NULL,\n\n  -- CRITICAL: point-in-time integrity (I-S2)\n  period_end DATE UNIQUE(ticker, period_end, filing_date, source)\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX idx_financial_ticker_period ON financial_statements(ticker, filing_date DESC, period_end DESC);\n```\n\nBacktest query MUST use event_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  event_version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n  payload JSONB NOT NULL,\n  occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),\n  published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,\n  sequence_num BIGSERIAL NOT NULL\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX idx_events_aggregate ON domain_events(aggregate_type, aggregate_id, occurred_at);\nCREATE INDEX idx_events_unpublished ON domain_events(occurred_at) WHERE published_at IS NULL;\n```\n\n## pgvector Semantic Search (Vietnamese)\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE article_embeddings (\n  article_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES news_articles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  embedding vector(1536) NOT NULL,  -- OpenAI text-embedding-3-small\n  model_version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text-embedding-3-small',\n  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()\n);\n\n-- HNSW index for $1::vector\nLIMIT 10;\n```\n\n## TimescaleDB Hypertable + Continuous Aggregate\n\n```sql\n-- Market data hypertable\nCREATE TABLE market_bars (\n  time TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,\n  ticker TEXT NOT NULL,\n  open NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,\n  high NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,\n  low NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,\n  close NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,\n  volume BIGINT NOT NULL,\n  foreign_buy_volume BIGINT,\n Contains verbatim SQL for the patterns referenced by the skill.\n\n## Aggregate Root Table\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE theses (\n  -- Identity\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),\n\n  -- References\n  ticker TEXT NOT NULL,\n  user_id UUID NOT NULL,\n\n  -- State\n  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'active', 'closed')),\n\n  -- Business content (JSONB for flexible structure)\n  bull_case JSONB NOT NULL,\n  bear_case JSONB NOT NULL,\n  catalysts JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',\n\n  -- Calibration\n  confidence_score NUMERIC(4,3) CHECK (confidence_score BETWEEN 0 AND 1),\n  hit_rate_basis INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- N past theses of this type\n\n  -- Temporal\n  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),\n  submitted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,\n  closed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,\n\n  -- Audit\n  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),\n  version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1  -- optimistic locking\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX idx_theses_ticker ON theses(ticker, created_at DESC);\nCREATE INDEX idx_theses_status ON theses(status) WHERE status IN ('draft', 'active');\n```\n\n## Point-in-Time Integrity (Fundamentals — I-S2)\n\nEvery fundamental data row MUST have BOTH dates:\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE financial_statements (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),\n  ticker TEXT NOT NULL,\n\n  -- CRITICAL: point-in-time integrity (I-S2)\n  period_end DATE NOT NULL,      -- what period this covers\n  filing_date DATE NOT NULL,     -- when it became public knowledge\n\n  -- Financials (all in VND million)\n  revenue BIGINT,\n  net_income BIGINT,\n  total_assets BIGINT,\n  total_equity BIGINT,\n\n  -- Source\n  source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('vnstock', 'fiinpro', 'manual')),\n  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),\n\n  UNIQUE(ticker, period_end, filing_date, source)\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX idx_financial_ticker_period ON financial_statements(ticker, filing_date DESC, period_end DESC);\n```\n\nBacktest query MUST use `filing_date` filter:\n\n```sql\n-- CORRECT: filters by when data was known (avoids look-ahead bias)\nSELECT * FROM financial_statements\nWHERE ticker = 'VCB'\n  AND filing_date <= '2024-03-31'::date\nORDER BY period_end DESC\nLIMIT 1;\n\n-- WRONG: would introduce look-ahead bias in backtest\n-- SELECT * FROM financial_statements WHERE ticker = 'VCB' ORDER BY period_end DESC LIMIT 1;\n```\n\n## Event Log Table\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE domain_events (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),\n  aggregate_id UUID NOT NULL,\n  aggregate_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  event_version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n  payload JSONB NOT NULL,\n  occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),\n  published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,\n  sequence_num BIGSERIAL NOT NULL\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX idx_events_aggregate ON domain_events(aggregate_type, aggregate_id, occurred_at);\nCREATE INDEX idx_events_unpublished ON domain_events(occurred_at) WHERE published_at IS NULL;\n```\n\n## pgvector Semantic Search (Vietnamese)\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE article_embeddings (\n  article_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES news_articles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  embedding vector(1536) NOT NULL,  -- OpenAI text-embedding-3-small\n  model_version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text-embedding-3-small',\n  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()\n);\n\n-- HNSW index for cosine similarity search\nCREATE INDEX idx_article_embeddings_hnsw ON article_embeddings\n  USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops)\n  WITH (m = 16, ef_construction = 64);\n```\n\nSemantic search query:\n\n```sql\nSELECT\n  ae.article_id,\n  1 - (ae.embedding <=> $1::vector) AS similarity\nFROM article_embeddings ae\nWHERE 1 - (ae.embedding <=> $1::vector) > 0.85\nORDER BY ae.embedding <=> $1::vector\nLIMIT 10;\n```\n\n## TimescaleDB Hypertable + Continuous Aggregate\n\n```sql\n-- Market data hypertable\nCREATE TABLE market_bars (\n  time TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,\n  ticker TEXT NOT NULL,\n  open NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,\n  high NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,\n  low NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,\n  close NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,\n  volume BIGINT NOT NULL,\n  foreign_buy_volume BIGINT,\n  foreign_sell_volume BIGINT\n);\n\nSELECT create_hypertable('market_bars', 'time');\n\nCREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_market_bars_ticker_time ON market_bars(ticker, time DESC);\n\n-- Continuous aggregate for daily OHLCV\nCREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW market_bars_daily\nWITH (timescaledb.continuous) AS\nSELECT\n  time_bucket('1 day', time) AS day,\n  ticker,\n  FIRST(open, time) AS open,\n  MAX(high) AS high,\n  MIN(low) AS low,\n  LAST(close, time) AS close,\n  SUM(volume) AS volume\nFROM market_bars\nGROUP BY day, ticker;\n```\n\n## Migration Conventions\n\n### File naming\n\n`apps/api/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_description.sql`\n\nExample: `20260420100000_create_theses_table.sql`\n\n### Structure\n\n```sql\n-- Up migration\nBEGIN;\n\nCREATE TABLE theses (/* ... */);\nCREATE INDEX /* ... */;\n\nCOMMIT;\n\n-- Down migration (in comment or separate file)\n-- BEGIN;\n-- DROP TABLE theses;\n-- COMMIT;\n```\n\n### Rules\n\n- Always wrap in `BEGIN`/`COMMIT`\n- Idempotent where possible (`IF NOT EXISTS`)\n- No data manipulation in schema migrations (use separate data migration)\n- Test up and down\n- One logical change per migration\n\n## Query Patterns\n\n### Explicit column list\n\n```python\n# Good\nrows = await db.fetch(\"\"\"\n    SELECT id, status, created_at\n    FROM theses\n    WHERE ticker = $1 AND status = 'active'\n    ORDER BY created_at DESC\n\"\"\", ticker)\n\n# Bad — SELECT *\n# rows = await db.fetch(\"SELECT * FROM theses WHERE ...\")\n```\n\n### Prepared statements (asyncpg)\n\n```python\n# Use parameterized queries always\nstmt = await conn.prepare(\"SELECT * FROM theses WHERE id = $1\")\nrow = await stmt.fetchrow(thesis_id)\n\n# Never string interpolation\n# await conn.fetch(f\"SELECT * FROM theses WHERE id = '{thesis_id}'\")  # SQL Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\n4\t---\n5\t\n6\t# Skill: DDD Tactical Patterns\n7\t\n8\t## Purpose\n9\t\n10\tApply Domain-Driven Design tactical patterns correctly in StockForge's Python stack.\n11\t\n12\t## When to Use\n13\t\n14\t- Designing a new aggregate\n15\t- Implementing repository Protocol for a new entity\n16\t- Creating domain events\n17\t- Building anti-corruption layer between BCs\n18\t- Deciding: entity vs value object vs aggregate root?\n19\t\n20\t## When NOT to Use\n21\t\n22\t- Simple CRUD with no business rules (use plain function)\n23\t- Infrastructure-layer utilities\n24\t- UI/presentation components\n25\t\n26\t## Key Decisions\n27\t\n28\t### Entity vs Value Object\n29\t\n30\t**Entity**: Has identity, lifecycle, mutable state.\n31\t- `Thesis`, `KolRecommendation`, `PumpDetection` (they have IDs, change over time)\n32\t\n33\t**Value Object**: Immutable, defined by its values, no identity.\n34\t- `Ticker`, `Money`, `Period`, `ThesisId`, `CredibilityScore`\n35\t\n36\tRule of thumb: if you would ask \"which one?\" → it's an entity. If you would ask \"what is it?\" → it's a value object.\n37\t\n38\t### Aggregate vs Entity\n39\t\n40\t**Aggregate**: Cluster of entities + value objects with a single root entity enforcing invariants.\n41\t- `Thesis` aggregate contains `BearCase`, `BullCase`, `Catalyst` list\n42\t- External code only touches aggregate root\n43\t\n44\tRule: aggregate boundary = transaction boundary = consistency boundary.\n45\t\n46\t## Aggregate Design Template\n47\t\n48\t```python\n49\t# packages/domain/analysis/models/thesis.py\n50\t\n51\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n52\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\n53\tfrom datetime import datetime\n54\tfrom enum import Enum\n55\t\n56\tfrom packages.domain.shared.aggregate_root import AggregateRoot\n57\tfrom packages.domain.shared.domain_event import DomainEvent\n58\tfrom packages.domain.analysis.value_objects.thesis_id import ThesisId\n59\tfrom packages.domain.analysis.value_objects.ticker import Ticker\n60\t\n61\t\n62\tclass ThesisStatus(Enum):\n63\t    DRAFT = \"draft\"\n64\t    ACTIVE = \"active\"\n65\t    CLOSED = \"closed\"\n66\t\n67\t\n68\t@dataclass\n69\tclass Thesis(AggregateRoot):\n70\t    id: ThesisId\n71\t    ticker: Ticker\n72\t    bull_case: BullCase\n73\t    bear_case: BearCase\n74\t    catalysts: list[Catalyst]\n75\t    confidence: ConfidenceScore\n76\t    status: ThesisStatus = ThesisStatus.DRAFT\n77\t    _events: list[DomainEvent] = field(default_factory=list, repr=False)\n78\t\n79\t    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n80\t        if not self.bear_case.is_substantive():\n81\t            raise InvariantViolation(\n82\t                \"Thesis must include substantive bear case (charter principle 3)\"\n83\t            )\n84\t\n85\t    @classmethod\n86\t    def create(cls, ticker: Ticker, bull: BullCase, bear: BearCase) -> Thesis:\n87\t        thesis = cls(\n88\t            id=ThesisId.generate(),\n89\t            ticker=ticker,\n90\t            bull_case=bull,\n91\t            bear_case=bear,\n92\t            catalysts=[],\n93\t            confidence=ConfidenceScore.unknown(),\n94\t        )\n95\t        thesis._events.append(ThesisCreatedEvent(thesis.id, thesis.ticker, datetime.utcnow()))\n96\t        return thesis\n97\t\n98\t    def add_catalyst(self, catalyst: Catalyst) -> None:\n99\t        if self.status != ThesisStatus.DRAFT:\n100\t            raise InvalidStateError(f\"Cannot add catalyst when thesis is {self.status}\")\n101\t        self.catalysts.append(catalyst)\n102\t        self._events.append(CatalystAddedEvent(self.id, catalyst.id))\n103\t\n104\t    def submit(self) -> None:\n105\t        if self.status != ThesisStatus.DRAFT:\n106\t            raise InvalidStateError(\"Can only submit draft theses\")\n107\t        if not self.bear_case.is_substantive():\n108\t            raise InvariantViolation(\"Bear case must be substantive before submitting\")\n109\t        self.status = ThesisStatus.ACTIVE\n110\t        self._events.append(ThesisSubmittedEvent(self.id, self.ticker, datetime.utcnow()))\n111\t\n112\t    def get_events(self) -> list[DomainEvent]:\n113\t        return list(self._events)\n114\t\n115\t    def clear_events(self) -> None:\n116\t        self._events.clear()\n117\t```\n118\t\n119\t## Rules Summary\n120\t\n121\t1. **Constructors validate** — `__post_init__` enforces invariants; impossible states unrepresentable\n122\t2. **State changes via methods** — no public attribute mutation\n123\t3. **Methods emit events** — every state change = domain event\n124\t4. **Return copies of collections** — don't leak mutable internals\n125\t5. **Validate in methods** — raise specific domain errors\n126\t6. **Use `@classmethod` factories** — `create()` and `reconstruct()`\n127\t\n128\t## Value Object Pattern\n129\t\n130\t```python\n131\t# packages/domain/shared/value_objects/ticker.py\n132\t\n133\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n134\t\n135\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n136\tclass Ticker:\n137\t    value: str\n138\t\n139\t    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n140\t        if not self.value or not self.value.isupper():\n141\t            raise ValueError(f\"Ticker must be uppercase: {self.value!r}\")\n142\t        if len(self.value) > 10:\n143\t            raise ValueError(f\"Ticker too long: {self.value!r}\")\n144\t\n145\t    @classmethod\n146\t    def from_str(cls, value: str) -> \"Ticker\":\n147\t        return cls(value=value.strip().upper())\n148\t\n149\t    def __str__(self) -> str:\n150\t        return self.value\n151\t```\n152\t\n153\t## Repository Pattern\n154\t\n155\tProtocol in domain, implementation in infrastructure.\n156\t\n157\t```python\n158\t# packages/domain/analysis/repositories/thesis_repository.py\n159\t\n160\tfrom typing import Protocol\n161\tfrom packages.domain.analysis.models.thesis import Thesis\n162\tfrom packages.domain.analysis.value_objects.thesis_id import ThesisId\n163\tfrom packages.domain.shared.value_objects.ticker import Ticker\n164\t\n165\t\n166\tclass ThesisRepository(Protocol):\n167\t    async def save(self, thesis: Thesis) -> None: ...\n168\t    async def find_by_id(self, id: ThesisId) -> Thesis | None: ...\n169\t    async def find_by_ticker(self, ticker: Ticker) -> list[Thesis]: None:\n176\t        self._db = db\n177\t\n178\t    async def save(self, thesis: Thesis) -> None:\n179\t        async with self._db.transaction() as tx:\n180\t            # Upsert thesis\n181\t            # Insert domain events\n182\t            pass\n183\t\n184\t    async def find_by_id(self, id: ThesisId) -> Thesis | None:\n185\t        row = await self._db.fetch_one(\"SELECT ... FROM theses WHERE id = $1\", str(id))\n186\t        if not row:\n187\t            return None\n188\t        return self._to_domain(row)\n189\t```\n190\t\n191\t## Cross-BC Communication\n192\t\n193\tNEVER import across bounded contexts directly. Use contracts.\n194\t\n195\t```python\n196\t# packages/contracts/events/thesis_events.py\n197\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n198\tfrom datetime import datetime\n199\t\n200\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n201\tclass ThesisCreatedEventContract:\n202\t    thesis_id: str\n203\t    ticker: str\n204\t    created_at: str  # ISO timestamp\n205\t\n206\t# In Analysis BC: publish ThesisCreatedEvent (uses contract shape)\n207\t# In Portfolio BC: subscribe to ThesisCreatedEventContract\n208\t#   → add to watchlist\n209\t```\n210\t\n211\t## Anti-Corruption Layer\n212\t\n213\tWhen integrating with external system (e.g., vnstock, FiinPro, scrapers):\n214\t\n215\t```python\n216\t# packages/infrastructure/fundamental/external/vnstock_adapter.py\n217\t\n218\tclass VnstockAdapter:\n219\t    def to_financial_statement(self, raw: dict) -> FinancialStatement:\n220\t        # Validate required fields\n221\t        if not raw.get(\"symbol\"):\n222\t            raise MissingFieldError(\"symbol\")\n223\t        if not raw.get(\"year\"):\n224\t            raise MissingFieldError(\"year\")\n225\t        \n226\t        # Transform from external schema to domain\n227\t        return FinancialStatement(\n228\t            ticker=Ticker.from_str(raw[\"symbol\"]),\n229\t            period_end=date(raw[\"year\"], raw.get(\"quarter\", 12), 31),\n230\t            filing_date=date.fromisoformat(raw.get(\"filing_date\", raw[\"year\"] + \"-03-31\")),\n231\t            revenue=Money.vnd(raw[\"revenue\"]),\n232\t            # ... other fields\n233\t        )\n234\t```\n235\t\n236\t## Common Mistakes\n237\t\n238\t### Anti-pattern: Anemic Model\n239\t```python\n240\t# BAD — logic lives in service, model is data bag\n241\t@dataclass\n242\tclass Thesis:\n243\t    id: str\n244\t    status: str\n245\t    bear_case: str\n246\t\n247\tclass ThesisService:\n248\t    def submit(self, thesis: Thesis) -> None:\n249\t        if thesis.status != 'draft':\n250\t            raise Exception(\"...\")\n251\t        thesis.status = 'active'  # direct mutation — wrong\n252\t```\n253\t\n254\t### Correct: Rich Model\n255\t```python\n256\t# GOOD — logic in the model itself\n257\t@dataclass\n258\tclass Thesis(AggregateRoot):\n259\t    def submit(self) -> None:\n260\t        if self.status != ThesisStatus.DRAFT:\n261\t            raise InvalidStateError(...)\n262\t        if not self.bear_case.is_substantive():\n263\t            raise InvariantViolation(...)\n264\t        self.status = ThesisStatus.ACTIVE\n265\t        self._events.append(ThesisSubmittedEvent(...))\n266\t```\n267\t\n268\t## Related Skills\n269\t\n270\t- `spec-dual-layer` — specs that reference these patterns\n271\t- `fastapi-module` — wire up DI for repositories (Phase 2+)\n272\t- `postgres-pgvector` — persistence for aggregates\n273\t"}]},"uuid":"f6bebdc5-7ee1-4117-8d84-a71586b5c9de","timestamp":"2026-04-29T14:33:12.722Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\.claude\\skills\\ddd-tactical-patterns\\SKILL.md","content":"---\nname: ddd-tactical-patterns\ndescription: Apply DDD tactical patterns (aggregate, entity, value object, repository, domain event, anti-corruption layer) correctly in Python/dataclasses code. If you would ask \"what is it?\" → it's a value object.\n\n### Aggregate vs Entity\n\n**Aggregate**: Cluster of entities + value objects with a single root entity enforcing invariants.\n- `Thesis` aggregate contains `BearCase`, `BullCase`, `Catalyst` list\n- External code only touches aggregate root\n\nRule: aggregate boundary = transaction boundary = consistency boundary.\n\n## Aggregate Design Template\n\n```python\n# packages/domain/analysis/models/thesis.py\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom enum import Enum\n\nfrom packages.domain.shared.aggregate_root import AggregateRoot\nfrom packages.domain.shared.domain_event import DomainEvent\nfrom packages.domain.analysis.value_objects.thesis_id import ThesisId\nfrom packages.domain.analysis.value_objects.ticker import Ticker\n\n\nclass ThesisStatus(Enum):\n    DRAFT = \"draft\"\n    ACTIVE = \"active\"\n    CLOSED = \"closed\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Thesis(AggregateRoot):\n    id: ThesisId\n    ticker: Ticker\n    bull_case: BullCase\n    bear_case: BearCase\n    catalysts: list[Catalyst]\n    confidence: ConfidenceScore\n    status: ThesisStatus = ThesisStatus.DRAFT\n    _events: list[DomainEvent] = field(default_factory=list, repr=False)\n\n    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n        if not self.bear_case.is_substantive():\n            raise InvariantViolation(\n                \"Thesis must include substantive bear case (charter principle 3)\"\n            )\n\n    @classmethod\n    def create(cls, ticker: Ticker, bull: BullCase, bear: BearCase) -> Thesis:\n        thesis = cls(\n            id=ThesisId.generate(),\n            ticker=ticker,\n            bull_case=bull,\n            bear_case=bear,\n            catalysts=[],\n            confidence=ConfidenceScore.unknown(),\n        )\n        thesis._events.append(ThesisCreatedEvent(thesis.id, thesis.ticker, datetime.utcnow()))\n        return thesis\n\n    def add_catalyst(self, catalyst: Catalyst) -> None:\n        if self.status != ThesisStatus.DRAFT:\n            raise InvalidStateError(f\"Cannot add catalyst when thesis is {self.status}\")\n        self.catalysts.append(catalyst)\n        self._events.append(CatalystAddedEvent(self.id, catalyst.id))\n\n    def submit(self) -> None:\n        if self.status != ThesisStatus.DRAFT:\n            raise InvalidStateError(\"Can only submit draft theses\")\n        if not self.bear_case.is_substantive():\n            raise InvariantViolation(\"Bear case must be substantive before submitting\")\n        self.status = ThesisStatus.ACTIVE\n        self._events.append(ThesisSubmittedEvent(self.id, self.ticker, datetime.utcnow()))\n\n    def get_events(self) -> list[DomainEvent]:\n        return list(self._events)\n\n    def clear_events(self) -> None:\n        self._events.clear()\n```\n\n## Rules Summary\n\n1. **Constructors validate** — `__post_init__` enforces invariants; impossible states unrepresentable\n2. **State changes via methods** — no public attribute mutation\n3. **Methods emit events** — every state change = domain event\n4. **Return copies of collections** — don't leak mutable internals\n5. **Validate in methods** — raise specific domain errors\n6. **Use `@classmethod` factories** — `create()` and `reconstruct()`\n\n## Value Object Pattern\n\n```python\n# packages/domain/shared/value_objects/ticker.py\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Ticker:\n    value: str\n\n    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n        if not self.value or not self.value.isupper():\n            raise ValueError(f\"Ticker must be uppercase: {self.value!r}\")\n        if len(self.value) > 10:\n            raise ValueError(f\"Ticker too long: {self.value!r}\")\n\n    @classmethod\n    def from_str(cls, value: str) -> \"Ticker\":\n        return cls(value=value.strip().upper())\n\n    def __str__(self) -> str:\n        return self.value\n```\n\n## Repository Pattern\n\nProtocol in domain, implementation in infrastructure.\n\n```python\n# packages/domain/analysis/repositories/thesis_repository.py\n\nfrom typing import Protocol\nfrom packages.domain.analysis.models.thesis import Thesis\nfrom packages.domain.analysis.value_objects.thesis_id import ThesisId\nfrom packages.domain.shared.value_objects.ticker import Ticker\n\n\nclass ThesisRepository(Protocol):\n    async def save(self, thesis: Thesis) -> None: ...\n    async def find_by_id(self, id: ThesisId) -> Thesis | None: ...\n    async def find_by_ticker(self, ticker: Ticker) -> list[Thesis]: ...\n\n\n# packages/infrastructure/analysis/persistence/thesis_postgres_repository.py\n\nclass ThesisPostgresRepository:\n    def __init__(self, db: DatabaseClient) -> None:\n        self._db = db\n\n    async def save(self, thesis: Thesis) -> None:\n        async with self._db.transaction() as tx:\n            # Upsert thesis\n            # Insert domain events\n            pass\n\n    async def find_by_id(self, id: ThesisId) -> Thesis | None:\n        row = await self._db.fetch_one(\"SELECT ... FROM theses WHERE id = $1\", str(id))\n        if not row:\n            return None\n        return self._to_domain(row)\n```\n\n## Cross-BC Communication\n\nNEVER import across bounded contexts directly. Use contracts.\n\n```python\n# packages/contracts/events/thesis_events.py\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ThesisCreatedEventContract:\n    thesis_id: str\n    ticker: str\n    created_at: str  # ISO timestamp\n\n# In Analysis BC: publish ThesisCreatedEvent (uses contract shape)\n# In Portfolio BC: subscribe to ThesisCreatedEventContract\n#   → add to watchlist\n```\n\n## Anti-Corruption Layer\n\nWhen integrating with external system (e.g., vnstock, FiinPro, scrapers):\n\n```python\n# packages/infrastructure/fundamental/external/vnstock_adapter.py\n\nclass VnstockAdapter:\n    def to_financial_statement(self, raw: dict) -> FinancialStatement:\n        # Validate required fields\n        if not raw.get(\"symbol\"):\n            raise MissingFieldError(\"symbol\")\n        if not raw.get(\"year\"):\n            raise MissingFieldError(\"year\")\n        \n        # Transform from external schema to domain\n        return FinancialStatement(\n            ticker=Ticker.from_str(raw[\"symbol\"]),\n            period_end=date(raw[\"year\"], raw.get(\"quarter\", 12), 31),\n            filing_date=date.fromisoformat(raw.get(\"filing_date\", raw[\"year\"] + \"-03-31\")),\n            revenue=Money.vnd(raw[\"revenue\"]),\n            # ... other fields\n        )\n```\n\n## Common Mistakes\n\n### Anti-pattern: Anemic Model\n```python\n# BAD — logic lives in service, model is data bag\n@dataclass\nclass Thesis:\n    id: str\n    status: str\n    bear_case: str\n\nclass ThesisService:\n    def submit(self, thesis: Thesis) -> None:\n        if thesis.status != 'draft':\n            raise Exception(\"...\")\n        thesis.status = 'active'  # direct mutation — wrong\n```\n\n### Correct: Rich Model\n```python\n# GOOD — logic in the model itself\n@dataclass\nclass Thesis(AggregateRoot):\n    def submit(self) -> None:\n        if self.status != ThesisStatus.DRAFT:\n            raise InvalidStateError(...)\n        if not self.bear_case.is_substantive():\n            raise InvariantViolation(...)\n        self.status = ThesisStatus.ACTIVE\n        self._events.append(ThesisSubmittedEvent(...))\n```\n\n## Related Skills\n\n- `spec-dual-layer` — specs that reference these patterns\n- `fastapi-module` — wire up DI for repositories (Phase 2+)\n- `postgres-pgvector` — persistence for aggregates\n","numLines":273,"startLine":1,"totalLines":273}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"f24c3e4b-c2a1-4717-9615-ceffb8c001e8","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"1691a5a8-8de7-439a-834f-1e05173f2431","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\nallowed-tools: [Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Edit, Write]\n---\n\n# Skill: DDD Tactical Patterns\n\n## Purpose\n\nApply Domain-Driven Design tactical patterns correctly in StockForge's Python stack. Domain layer is pure Python (`packages/domain/`) — dataclasses only, NO Pydantic, NO framework imports. Persistence + transport translate at the edges.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- Designing a new aggregate\n- Implementing repository Protocol for a new entity\n- Creating domain events\n- Building anti-corruption layer between BCs\n- Deciding: entity vs value object vs aggregate root?\n\n## When NOT to Use\n\n- Simple CRUD with no business rules — plain function is fine\n- Infrastructure-layer utilities — DDD is a domain-layer doctrine\n- UI / presentation components — keep them framework-aware\n- Phase 1 prototype scripts — domain-layer rigor is Phase 2+\n\n## Key Decisions\n\n### Entity vs Value Object\n\n| | Entity | Value Object |\n|---|---|---|\n| Identity | Has ID | None |\n| Lifecycle | Mutable | Immutable (`frozen=True`) |\n| Equality | By ID | By all fields |\n| Question | \"Which one?\" | \"What is it?\" |\n| Examples | `Thesis`, `KolRecommendation`, `PumpDetection` | `Ticker`, `Money`, `Period`, `ThesisId`, `CredibilityScore` |\n\n### Aggregate vs Entity\n\n**Aggregate** = cluster of entities + value objects with a single root entity enforcing invariants. External code only touches the aggregate root.\n\nRule: **aggregate boundary = transaction boundary = consistency boundary**. One aggregate per transaction.\n\nExample: `Thesis` aggregate contains `BearCase`, `BullCase`, `Catalyst` list — `BearCase` is never loaded or mutated independently of its `Thesis`.\n\n### Repository Placement\n\n- **Protocol** lives in `packages/domain/<bc>/repositories/<name>_repository.py` — pure typing, no framework imports\n- **Implementation** lives in `packages/infrastructure/<bc>/persistence/<name>_postgres_repository.py` — translates between domain ↔ rows\n\n## Aggregate Rules\n\n1. **Constructors validate** — `__post_init__` enforces invariants; impossible states unrepresentable\n2. **State changes via methods** — no public attribute mutation from outside\n3. **Methods emit events** — every state change appends to `_events: list[DomainEvent]`\n4. **Return copies of collections** — don't leak mutable internals (`return list(self._catalysts)`)\n5. **Validate in methods** — raise specific domain errors (`InvariantViolation`, `InvalidStateError`)\n6. **Use `@classmethod` factories** — `create()` for new instances, `reconstruct()` for repository hydration\n\n## Cross-BC Communication\n\nNEVER import directly across bounded contexts. Use **contracts** in `packages/contracts/`:\n\n- BC A publishes `events/<bc-a>_events.py` defining the event shape\n- BC B subscribes to that contract; never imports BC A's domain\n- Translation between domain event ↔ contract event happens at the publish boundary\n\nIf you find yourself writing `from packages.domain.<bc-a>` inside `packages/domain/<bc-b>/` — STOP, route via contract instead.\n\n## Anti-Corruption Layer (ACL)\n\nWhen integrating with an external system (vnstock, FiinPro, scrapers), put translation in `packages/infrastructure/<bc>/external/<source>_adapter.py`:\n\n- Validate required external fields → raise `MissingFieldError` early\n- Transform external schema → domain value objects (`Ticker.from_str`, `Money.vnd`)\n- Domain layer never sees raw external dict\n\nThe adapter is the only place that knows the external schema. If the external schema changes, only the adapter changes.\n\n## Common Mistakes\n\n- **Anemic Model**: state mutation lives in service, model is a data bag. Symptom: `thesis.status = 'active'` from outside the aggregate.\n- **Entity-as-VO**: giving a VO an ID, or making an entity `frozen=True`. Pick one.\n- **Aggregate too large**: every transaction loads + locks the whole tree. If load + save thrashes, split.\n- **Aggregate too small**: invariants span aggregates and become eventually-consistent when they should be transactional. If you find yourself wrapping two repository saves in one application service, the aggregate boundary is wrong.\n- **Repository leaks raw rows**: caller deals with `dict[str, Any]`. Always hydrate to domain object inside repo.\n- **Cross-BC import**: `from packages.domain.kol_tracking.kol import Kol` inside `packages/domain/analysis/` — replace with contract.\n\n## Validation Pre-Conditions\n\n- Aggregate root inherits `AggregateRoot` mixin → has `_events` list + `get_events()` + `clear_events()`\n- Value object is `@dataclass(frozen=True)` + `__post_init__` validation\n- Repository Protocol methods are `async`\n- No `from fastapi`, `from pydantic`, `from sqlalchemy` in `packages/domain/**`\n- No cross-BC imports (`from packages.domain.<other_bc>` from inside another BC's domain)\n\n## Smoke Test\n\nFor task \"model a KOL recommendation as an aggregate\":\n\nExpected output shape:\n- `KolRecommendation(AggregateRoot)` — root entity with id (`KolRecommendationId` VO), kol_id (`KolId` VO), ticker (`Ticker` VO), action (enum), recommended_at, source_url, confidence (`CredibilityScore` VO derived)\n- Value objects: `KolRecommendationId`, `KolId`, `Ticker`, `CredibilityScore` — all frozen dataclasses with validation\n- Repository Protocol in `packages/domain/kol_tracking/repositories/`; implementation NOT in domain\n- `KolRecommendation.create()` factory + `submit()` method emitting `KolRecommendationSubmittedEvent`\n- Cross-BC: `analysis` BC subscribes to a contract version of the event, NOT the domain event directly\n\nIf proposal includes all of the above and no Pydantic / FastAPI imports in domain → skill is functional.\n\n## See Also\n\n- `references/code-templates.md` — full Python templates (aggregate root, VO, repository, ACL, anemic vs rich)\n- `spec-dual-layer` SKILL.md — specs that drive these implementations\n- `fastapi-module` SKILL.md — wire DI for repositories at the edge (Phase 2+)\n- `postgres-pgvector` SKILL.md — persistence schema for these aggregates\n- `agent-workspace/constitution/architecture.md` — 9 BC list + boundary rules\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":8827,"cache_read_input_tokens":133052,"output_tokens":5638,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":8827,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":5638,"cache_read_input_tokens":133052,"cache_creation_input_tokens":8827,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":8827},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CaYE9TGBdcR9xZm5dB9HZ","type":"assistant","uuid":"b233473d-ba18-4516-ab60-412659b2c9bf","timestamp":"2026-04-29T14:34:02.248Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"1691a5a8-8de7-439a-834f-1e05173f2431","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\nallowed-tools: [Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Edit, Write]\n---\n\n# Skill: DDD Tactical Patterns\n\n## Purpose\n\nApply Domain-Driven Design tactical patterns correctly in StockForge's Python stack. Domain layer is pure Python (`packages/domain/`) — dataclasses only, NO Pydantic, NO framework imports. Persistence + transport translate at the edges.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- Designing a new aggregate\n- Implementing repository Protocol for a new entity\n- Creating domain events\n- Building anti-corruption layer between BCs\n- Deciding: entity vs value object vs aggregate root?\n\n## When NOT to Use\n\n- Simple CRUD with no business rules — plain function is fine\n- Infrastructure-layer utilities — DDD is a domain-layer doctrine\n- UI / presentation components — keep them framework-aware\n- Phase 1 prototype scripts — domain-layer rigor is Phase 2+\n\n## Key Decisions\n\n### Entity vs Value Object\n\n| | Entity | Value Object |\n|---|---|---|\n| Identity | Has ID | None |\n| Lifecycle | Mutable | Immutable (`frozen=True`) |\n| Equality | By ID | By all fields |\n| Question | \"Which one?\" | \"What is it?\" |\n| Examples | `Thesis`, `KolRecommendation`, `PumpDetection` | `Ticker`, `Money`, `Period`, `ThesisId`, `CredibilityScore` |\n\n### Aggregate vs Entity\n\n**Aggregate** = cluster of entities + value objects with a single root entity enforcing invariants. External code only touches the aggregate root.\n\nRule: **aggregate boundary = transaction boundary = consistency boundary**. One aggregate per transaction.\n\nExample: `Thesis` aggregate contains `BearCase`, `BullCase`, `Catalyst` list — `BearCase` is never loaded or mutated independently of its `Thesis`.\n\n### Repository Placement\n\n- **Protocol** lives in `packages/domain/<bc>/repositories/<name>_repository.py` — pure typing, no framework imports\n- **Implementation** lives in `packages/infrastructure/<bc>/persistence/<name>_postgres_repository.py` — translates between domain ↔ rows\n\n## Aggregate Rules\n\n1. **Constructors validate** — `__post_init__` enforces invariants; impossible states unrepresentable\n2. **State changes via methods** — no public attribute mutation from outside\n3. **Methods emit events** — every state change appends to `_events: list[DomainEvent]`\n4. **Return copies of collections** — don't leak mutable internals (`return list(self._catalysts)`)\n5. **Validate in methods** — raise specific domain errors (`InvariantViolation`, `InvalidStateError`)\n6. **Use `@classmethod` factories** — `create()` for new instances, `reconstruct()` for repository hydration\n\n## Cross-BC Communication\n\nNEVER import directly across bounded contexts. Use **contracts** in `packages/contracts/`:\n\n- BC A publishes `events/<bc-a>_events.py` defining the event shape\n- BC B subscribes to that contract; never imports BC A's domain\n- Translation between domain event ↔ contract event happens at the publish boundary\n\nIf you find yourself writing `from packages.domain.<bc-a>` inside `packages/domain/<bc-b>/` — STOP, route via contract instead.\n\n## Anti-Corruption Layer (ACL)\n\nWhen integrating with an external system (vnstock, FiinPro, scrapers), put translation in `packages/infrastructure/<bc>/external/<source>_adapter.py`:\n\n- Validate required external fields → raise `MissingFieldError` early\n- Transform external schema → domain value objects (`Ticker.from_str`, `Money.vnd`)\n- Domain layer never sees raw external dict\n\nThe adapter is the only place that knows the external schema. If the external schema changes, only the adapter changes.\n\n## Common Mistakes\n\n- **Anemic Model**: state mutation lives in service, model is a data bag. Symptom: `thesis.status = 'active'` from outside the aggregate.\n- **Entity-as-VO**: giving a VO an ID, or making an entity `frozen=True`. Pick one.\n- **Aggregate too large**: every transaction loads + locks the whole tree. If load + save thrashes, split.\n- **Aggregate too small**: invariants span aggregates and become eventually-consistent when they should be transactional. If you find yourself wrapping two repository saves in one application service, the aggregate boundary is wrong.\n- **Repository leaks raw rows**: caller deals with `dict[str, Any]`. Always hydrate to domain object inside repo.\n- **Cross-BC import**: `from packages.domain.kol_tracking.kol import Kol` inside `packages/domain/analysis/` — replace with contract.\n\n## Validation Pre-Conditions\n\n- Aggregate root inherits `AggregateRoot` mixin → has `_events` list + `get_events()` + `clear_events()`\n- Value object is `@dataclass(frozen=True)` + `__post_init__` validation\n- Repository Protocol methods are `async`\n- No `from fastapi`, `from pydantic`, `from sqlalchemy` in `packages/domain/**`\n- No cross-BC imports (`from packages.domain.<other_bc>` from inside another BC's domain)\n\n## Smoke Test\n\nFor task \"model a KOL recommendation as an aggregate\":\n\nExpected output shape:\n- `KolRecommendation(AggregateRoot)` — root entity with id (`KolRecommendationId` VO), kol_id (`KolId` VO), ticker (`Ticker` VO), action (enum), recommended_at, source_url, confidence (`CredibilityScore` VO derived)\n- Value objects: `KolRecommendationId`, `KolId`, `Ticker`, `CredibilityScore` — all frozen dataclasses with validation\n- Repository Protocol in `packages/domain/kol_tracking/repositories/`; implementation NOT in domain\n- `KolRecommendation.create()` factory + `submit()` method emitting `KolRecommendationSubmittedEvent`\n- Cross-BC: `analysis` BC subscribes to a contract version of the event, NOT the domain event directly\n\nIf proposal includes all of the above and no Pydantic / FastAPI imports in domain → skill is functional.\n\n## See Also\n\n- `references/code-templates.md` — full Python templates (aggregate root, VO, repository, ACL, anemic vs rich)\n- `spec-dual-layer` SKILL.md — specs that drive these implementations\n- `fastapi-module` SKILL.md — wire DI for repositories at the edge (Phase 2+)\n- `postgres-pgvector` SKILL.md — persistence schema for these aggregates\n- `agent-workspace/constitution/architecture.md` — 9 BC list + boundary rules\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":13,"newStart":1,"newLines":14,"lines":[" ---"," name: ddd-tactical-patterns"," description: Apply DDD tactical patterns (aggregate, entity, value object, repository, domain event, anti-corruption layer) correctly in Python/dataclasses code. Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\n---\n\n# Skill: DDD Tactical Patterns\n\n## Purpose\n\nApply Domain-Driven Design tactical patterns correctly in StockForge's Python stack.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- Designing a new aggregate\n- Implementing repository Protocol for a new entity\n- Creating domain events\n- Building anti-corruption layer between BCs\n- Deciding: entity vs value object vs aggregate root?\n\n## When NOT to Use\n\n- Simple CRUD with no business rules (use plain function)\n- Infrastructure-layer utilities\n- UI/presentation components\n\n## Key Decisions\n\n### Entity vs Value Object\n\n**Entity**: Has identity, lifecycle, mutable state.\n- `Thesis`, `KolRecommendation`, `PumpDetection` (they have IDs, change over time)\n\n**Value Object**: Immutable, defined by its values, no identity.\n- `Ticker`, `Money`, `Period`, `ThesisId`, `CredibilityScore`\n\nRule of thumb: if you would ask \"which one?\" → it's an entity. If you would ask \"what is it?\" → it's a value object.\n\n### Aggregate vs Entity\n\n**Aggregate**: Cluster of entities + value objects with a single root entity enforcing invariants.\n- `Thesis` aggregate contains `BearCase`, `BullCase`, `Catalyst` list\n- External code only touches aggregate root\n\nRule: aggregate boundary = transaction boundary = consistency boundary.\n\n## Aggregate Design Template\n\n```python\n# packages/domain/analysis/models/thesis.py\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom enum import Enum\n\nfrom packages.domain.shared.aggregate_root import AggregateRoot\nfrom packages.domain.shared.domain_event import DomainEvent\nfrom packages.domain.analysis.value_objects.thesis_id import ThesisId\nfrom packages.domain.analysis.value_objects.ticker import Ticker\n\n\nclass ThesisStatus(Enum):\n    DRAFT = \"draft\"\n    ACTIVE = \"active\"\n    CLOSED = \"closed\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Thesis(AggregateRoot):\n    id: ThesisId\n    ticker: Ticker\n    bull_case: BullCase\n    bear_case: BearCase\n    catalysts: list[Catalyst]\n    confidence: ConfidenceScore\n    status: ThesisStatus = ThesisStatus.DRAFT\n    _events: list[DomainEvent] = field(default_factory=list, repr=False)\n\n    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n        if not self.bear_case.is_substantive():\n            raise InvariantViolation(\n                \"Thesis must include substantive bear case (charter principle 3)\"\n            )\n\n    @classmethod\n    def create(cls, ticker: Ticker, bull: BullCase, bear: BearCase) -> Thesis:\n        thesis = cls(\n            id=ThesisId.generate(),\n            ticker=ticker,\n            bull_case=bull,\n            bear_case=bear,\n            catalysts=[],\n            confidence=ConfidenceScore.unknown(),\n        )\n        thesis._events.append(ThesisCreatedEvent(thesis.id, thesis.ticker, datetime.utcnow()))\n        return thesis\n\n    def add_catalyst(self, catalyst: Catalyst) -> None:\n        if self.status != ThesisStatus.DRAFT:\n            raise InvalidStateError(f\"Cannot add catalyst when thesis is {self.status}\")\n        self.catalysts.append(catalyst)\n        self._events.append(CatalystAddedEvent(self.id, catalyst.id))\n\n    def submit(self) -> None:\n        if self.status != ThesisStatus.DRAFT:\n            raise InvalidStateError(\"Can only submit draft theses\")\n        if not self.bear_case.is_substantive():\n            raise InvariantViolation(\"Bear case must be substantive before submitting\")\n        self.status = ThesisStatus.ACTIVE\n        self._events.append(ThesisSubmittedEvent(self.id, self.ticker, datetime.utcnow()))\n\n    def get_events(self) -> list[DomainEvent]:\n        return list(self._events)\n\n    def clear_events(self) -> None:\n        self._events.clear()\n```\n\n## Rules Summary\n\n1. **Constructors validate** — `__post_init__` enforces invariants; impossible states unrepresentable\n2. **State changes via methods** — no public attribute mutation\n3. **Methods emit events** — every state change = domain event\n4. **Return copies of collections** — don't leak mutable internals\n5. **Validate in methods** — raise specific domain errors\n6. **Use `@classmethod` factories** — `create()` and `reconstruct()`\n\n## Value Object Pattern\n\n```python\n# packages/domain/shared/value_objects/ticker.py\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Ticker:\n    value: str\n\n    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n        if not self.value or not self.value.isupper():\n            raise ValueError(f\"Ticker must be uppercase: {self.value!r}\")\n        if len(self.value) > 10:\n            raise ValueError(f\"Ticker too long: {self.value!r}\")\n\n    @classmethod\n    def from_str(cls, value: str) -> \"Ticker\":\n        return cls(value=value.strip().upper())\n\n    def __str__(self) -> str:\n        return self.value\n```\n\n## Repository Pattern\n\nProtocol in domain, implementation in infrastructure.\n\n```python\n# packages/domain/analysis/repositories/thesis_repository.py\n\nfrom typing import Protocol\nfrom packages.domain.analysis.models.thesis import Thesis\nfrom packages.domain.analysis.value_objects.thesis_id import ThesisId\nfrom packages.domain.shared.value_objects.ticker import Ticker\n\n\nclass ThesisRepository(Protocol):\n    async def save(self, thesis: Thesis) -> None: ...\n    async def find_by_id(self, id: ThesisId) -> Thesis | None: ...\n    async def find_by_ticker(self, ticker: Ticker) -> list[Thesis]: ...\n\n\n# packages/infrastructure/analysis/persistence/thesis_postgres_repository.py\n\nclass ThesisPostgresRepository:\n    def __init__(self, db: DatabaseClient) -> None:\n        self._db = db\n\n    async def save(self, thesis: Thesis) -> None:\n        async with self._db.transaction() as tx:\n            # Upsert thesis\n            # Insert domain events\n            pass\n\n    async def find_by_id(self, id: ThesisId) -> Thesis | None:\n        row = await self._db.fetch_one(\"SELECT ... FROM theses WHERE id = $1\", str(id))\n        if not row:\n            return None\n        return self._to_domain(row)\n```\n\n## Cross-BC Communication\n\nNEVER import across bounded contexts directly. Use contracts.\n\n```python\n# packages/contracts/events/thesis_events.py\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ThesisCreatedEventContract:\n    thesis_id: str\n    ticker: str\n    created_at: str  # ISO timestamp\n\n# In Analysis BC: publish ThesisCreatedEvent (uses contract shape)\n# In Portfolio BC: subscribe to ThesisCreatedEventContract\n#   → add to watchlist\n```\n\n## Anti-Corruption Layer\n\nWhen integrating with external system (e.g., vnstock, FiinPro, scrapers):\n\n```python\n# packages/infrastructure/fundamental/external/vnstock_adapter.py\n\nclass VnstockAdapter:\n    def to_financial_statement(self, raw: dict) -> FinancialStatement:\n        # Validate required fields\n        if not raw.get(\"symbol\"):\n            raise MissingFieldError(\"symbol\")\n        if not raw.get(\"year\"):\n            raise MissingFieldError(\"year\")\n        \n        # Transform from external schema to domain\n        return FinancialStatement(\n            ticker=Ticker.from_str(raw[\"symbol\"]),\n            period_end=date(raw[\"year\"], raw.get(\"quarter\", 12), 31),\n            filing_date=date.fromisoformat(raw.get(\"filing_date\", raw[\"year\"] + \"-03-31\")),\n            revenue=Money.vnd(raw[\"revenue\"]),\n            # ... other fields\n        )\n```\n\n## Common Mistakes\n\n### Anti-pattern: Anemic Model\n```python\n# BAD — logic lives in service, model is data bag\n@dataclass\nclass Thesis:\n    id: str\n    status: str\n    bear_case: str\n\nclass ThesisService:\n    def submit(self, thesis: Thesis) -> None:\n        if thesis.status != 'draft':\n            raise Exception(\"...\")\n        thesis.status = 'active'  # direct mutation — wrong\n```\n\n### Correct: Rich Model\n```python\n# GOOD — logic in the model itself\n@dataclass\nclass Thesis(AggregateRoot):\n    def submit(self) -> None:\n        if self.status != ThesisStatus.DRAFT:\n            raise InvalidStateError(...)\n        if not self.bear_case.is_substantive():\n            raise InvariantViolation(...)\n        self.status = ThesisStatus.ACTIVE\n        self._events.append(ThesisSubmittedEvent(...))\n```\n\n## Related Skills\n\n- `spec-dual-layer` — specs that reference these patterns\n- `fastapi-module` — wire up DI for repositories (Phase 2+)\n- `postgres-pgvector` — persistence for aggregates\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"b233473d-ba18-4516-ab60-412659b2c9bf","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"1691a5a8-8de7-439a-834f-1e05173f2431","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

 pass\n\n    async def find_by_id(self, id: ThesisId) -> Thesis | None:\n        row = await self._db.fetch_one(\"SELECT ... FROM theses WHERE id = $1\", str(id))\n        if not row:\n            return None\n        return self._to_domain(row)\n```\n\n## Cross-BC Contract\n\n```python\n# packages/contracts/events/thesis_events.py\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ThesisCreatedEventContract:\n    thesis_id: str\n    ticker: str\n    created_at: str  # ISO timestamp\n\n# In Analysis BC: publish ThesisCreatedEvent (uses contract shape)\n# In Portfolio BC: subscribe to ThesisCreatedEventContract\n#   → add to watchlist\n```\n\n## Anti-Corruption Layer (ACL)\n\n```python\n# packages/infrastructure/fundamental/external/vnstock_adapter.py\n\nclass VnstockAdapter:\n    def to_financial_statement(self, raw: dict) -> FinancialStatement:\n        # Validate required fields\n        if not raw.get(\"symbol\"):\n            raise MissingFieldError(\"symbol\")\n        if not raw.get(\"year\"):\n            raise MissingFieldError(\"year\")\n\n        # Transform from external schema to domain\n        return FinancialStatement(\n            ticker=Ticker.from_str(raw[\"symbol\"]),\n            period_end=date(raw[\"year\"], raw.get(\"quarter\", 12), 31),\n            filing_date=date.fromisoformat(raw.get(\"filing_date\", raw[\"year\"] + \"-03-31\")),\n            revenue=Money.vnd(raw[\"revenue\"]),\n            # ... other fields\n        )\n```\n\n## Anemic vs Rich Model\n\n**Anti-pattern — Anemic Model** (logic lives in service, model is a data bag):\n\n```python\n# BAD\n@dataclass\nclass Thesis:\n    id: str\n    status: str\n    bear_case: str\n\nclass ThesisService:\n    def submit(self, thesis: Thesis) -> None:\n        if thesis.status != 'draft':\n            raise Exception(\"...\")\n        thesis.status = 'active'  # direct mutation — wrong\n```\n\n**Correct — Rich Model** (logic in the model itself):\n\n```python\n# GOOD\n@dataclass\nclass Thesis(AggregateRoot):\n    def submit(self) -> None:\n        if self.status != ThesisStatus.DRAFT:\n            raise InvalidStateError(...)\n        if not self.bear_case.is_substantive():\n            raise InvariantViolation(...)\n        self.status = ThesisStatus.ACTIVE\n        self._events.append(ThesisSubmittedEvent(...))\n```\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"bd6462a7-b632-4d01-b985-ed00f0cff1ea","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"1691a5a8-8de7-439a-834f-1e05173f2431","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"2addf0ee-d1b3-470d-a1f5-6e51dc0a7dfa","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"skill_listing","content":"- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors (\"from now on when X\", \"each time X\", \"whenever X\", \"before/after X\") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions (\"allow X\", \"add permission\", \"move permission to\"), env vars (\"set X=Y\"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: \"allow npm commands\", \"add bq permission to global settings\", \"move permission to user settings\", \"set DEBUG=true\", \"when claude stops show X\". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.\n- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: \"rebind ctrl+s\", \"add a chord shortcut\", \"change the submit key\", \"customize keybindings\".\n- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.\n- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.\n- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. \"check the deploy every 5 minutes\", \"keep running /babysit-prs\"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.\n- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run (\"run this once at 3pm\", \"remind me to check X tomorrow\").\n- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).\nTRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.\nSKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.\n- ccs-delegation: Auto-activate CCS CLI delegation for deterministic tasks. Parses user input, auto-selects optimal profile (glm/kimi/custom) from ~/.ccs/config.json, enhances prompts with context, executes via `ccs {profile} -p \"task\"` or `ccs {profile}:continue`, and reports results. Triggers on \"use ccs [task]\" patterns, typo/test/refactor keywords. Excludes complex architecture, security-critical code, performance optimization, breaking changes.\n- attach: Port the Claude Code harness layer from this project to a new project directory. Use when bootstrapping a fresh Claude Code project on the same machine, when peers want to copy the harness, or when verifying layer separation via dry-run. Reads .claude/manifest.yaml; copies harness-tagged artifacts only; excludes stockforge biz + personal layers; generates skeleton CLAUDE.md + manifest at target.\n- crawler-reliability: Build reliable web crawlers for data gathering. Use when implementing scrapers for CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz, YouTube (yt-dlp), Facebook fanpages, or any external data source. Covers Python/Playwright patterns, retry/backoff, selector robustness, rate limiting, monitoring.\n- ddd-tactical-patterns: Apply DDD tactical patterns (aggregate, entity, value object, repository, domain event, anti-corruption layer) correctly in Python/dataclasses code. Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\n- decompose-work: Split a non-trivial task into deterministic-vs-LLM portions before execution. Use when planning multi-step work where some sub-tasks are mechanical (file ops, regex, count, schema validation) and others require judgment (synthesis, design, ambiguity resolution). Outputs structured plan that maps each portion to the cheapest competent tool. Pairs with capability-map.md (model × effort × task_class grounding) and try-n-approaches (S9 — Karpathy autoresearch loop).\n- evidence-extraction: Extract structured claims from unstructured sources with citation integrity. Use when building extraction pipelines, parsing news articles or KOL transcripts, or anywhere claims are created from raw data. Ensures every claim has source_url, extracted_at, confidence, and verified attribution. Enforces no-LLM-math invariant (I-S1).\n- fastapi-module: Implement FastAPI routers following StockForge conventions. Use when creating a new HTTP endpoint, adding routes, wiring dependency injection, configuring Pydantic DTOs. Covers router boundaries, provider patterns, testing setup. Phase 2+ only — Phase 1 uses Streamlit dashboard directly.\n- grill-maximization: Doctrine for bundling Q&A questions to the human at maximum density per turn (15-20 target, max 25), so each human-in-the-loop touchpoint is information-rich. Use when composing a Q&A bundle for human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, or when deciding whether to ask one question or wait and bundle. Built on the principle that human-in-the-loop time is the scarcest resource in autonomous coding.\n- obsidian-vault: Search, create, and manage notes in the StockForge Obsidian vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index maintenance. Use when adding content to the knowledge base, navigating entities/concepts, or maintaining the raw/wiki separation. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\n- postgres-pgvector: Design Postgres schemas with pgvector and TimescaleDB for StockForge. Use when creating migrations, designing tables, writing queries. Covers vector embeddings for semantic search on Vietnamese text, time-series for price/sentiment data, JSONB vs structured columns.\n- promote-rule: Cluster agent-notes.md entries by lexical similarity, propose promotion of recurring rules to deterministic hook (priority 1), skill (priority 2), or charter (priority 3). Use when agent-notes has accumulated ≥10 new rules since last promotion run, or on-demand at phase boundary. Outputs proposal markdown to observations/. Pairs with capability-map.md (writes new task_class entries) and decompose-work (consumes promotion outcomes).\n- prompt-engineering: Design and optimize LLM prompts for StockForge pipeline stages. Use when writing or refining prompts for claim extraction, KOL recommendation extraction, sentiment analysis, thesis synthesis. Covers context assembly, prompt caching strategy, budget-aware prompts, structured output. Enforces no-LLM-math constraint.\n- qa-escalation: File-based Q&A protocol — composes bundle file in human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, tracks lifecycle (pending → answered → stale → processed), creates URGENT notification when needed. Use when intent classifier recommends OPEN_QA_BUNDLE / ESCALATE_HUMAN, or grill-maximization has a bundle ready to write. Pairs with grill-maximization (composes content) + Track 5 hooks (auto-move stale).\n- spec-dual-layer: Write specifications with dual-layer structure (business narrative + agent contract). Use when authoring new specs, refining existing specs, or understanding the spec template. Ensures both human stakeholder needs and agent execution needs are served.\n- spec-to-wiki: Convert raw specifications to Obsidian wiki format with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index updates. Use when adding a new spec to the knowledge base, or when regenerating wiki view after spec changes. Maintains raw as source of truth, wiki as navigable view.\n- test-pyramid-balance: Balance unit, integration, and E2E tests properly in Python/pytest. Use when deciding what test to write, reviewing test coverage, or rebalancing skewed test suite. Covers test pyramid shape, BDD vs unit tests, when to use what. Includes stock-domain-specific test categories.\n- try-n-approaches: Karpathy autoresearch outer-loop framing — given a task or signal, generate ≥3 distinct approaches (DEEPEN / BROADEN / ABANDON families), pick one per cheap-first ordering, attach a deterministic metric function (per L-S12-1), and write the experiment frame to learning-data/loop/. Use when an open question surfaces from drift / dogfood / sync-grilling and you need to commit a measurable next step. Pairs with decompose-work (deterministic-vs-LLM split per approach) + capability-map (model × effort grounding) + promote-rule (consumes outcomes).\n- ubiquitous-language: Extract a DDD-style ubiquitous language glossary from the current conversation or domain area. Use when starting work on a new bounded context, when new domain terms emerge, or when verifying consistency between business language and code. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed.\n- user-prompt-intake: Hybrid intent classifier — main session lite-detects trivial prompts, dispatches intent-classifier subagent for complex ones. Use whenever a new user prompt lands (chat or file in human-workspace/user_prompt/) and you need to route the work. Built for full-autonomous loop where every prompt must be classified before action.\n- write-a-skill: Create new Claude Code skills with proper structure, progressive disclosure, and discoverability. Use when extracting a pattern from multiple sessions into a reusable skill, or when user asks to formalize a technique. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed.\n- ccs:continue: Continue last CCS delegation session [AUTO ENHANCE]\n- ccs: Delegate task with intelligent profile selection [AUTO ENHANCE]\n- budget-check: /budget-check — Current Session Token Budget Status\n- devils-advocate: /devils-advocate — Adversarial Critique\n- drift-check: /drift-check — Run Drift Signals DR1-DR12\n- drill-me: /drill-me — Interactive Ubiquitous Language Extraction\n- grill-me: /grill-me — Relentless Plan/Design Interview\n- handoff-read: /handoff-read — Lightweight Last Session Load\n- master-plan: /master-plan — High-Level Work Decomposition\n- session-end: /session-end — Close Work Session\n- session-start: /session-start — Begin Work Session\n- session-verify: /session-verify — Mid-Session Alignment Check\n- spec-author: /spec-author — Create Dual-Layer Specification\n- spec-to-wiki: /spec-to-wiki — Convert Raw Spec to Obsidian Wiki Format\n- ul-audit: /ul-audit — Audit Ubiquitous Language Consistency\n- vbw-check: /vbw-check — Apply Verify-Before-Write Protocol\n- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation\n- review: Review a pull request\n- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch","skillCount":46,"isInitial":true},"type":"attachment","uuid":"45d74223-6fe7-46c8-b41b-606aeef01120","timestamp":"2026-04-29T14:34:27.126Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"1691a5a8-8de7-439a-834f-1e05173f2431","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}
