See `references/section-checklists.md` for the full section-by-section content list.","originalFile":"---\nname: spec-dual-layer\ndescription: Write specifications with dual-layer structure (business narrative + agent contract). Use when authoring new specs, refining existing specs, or understanding the spec template. Ensures both human stakeholder needs and agent execution needs are served.\nallowed-tools: [Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Edit, Write]\n---\n\n# Skill: Dual-Layer Spec Authoring\n\n## Purpose\n\nEvery feature spec serves two audiences:\n- **Human stakeholder** needs narrative, context, rationale\n- **AI agent** needs structure, unambiguous contracts, machine-verifiable\n\nDual-layer specs serve both without compromise — Part A is for humans, Part B is for agents.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- Writing any Tier 2 (feature) or Tier 3 (task) spec\n- Refactoring existing spec to dual-layer format\n- Reviewing a spec for completeness\n\n## Reference Template\n\n`/SPEC_TEMPLATE.md` at project root is canonical. Three parts:\n\n| Part | Audience | Purpose |\n|---|---|---|\n| **Part A** — Business Specification | Stakeholder | Narrative — context, users, rules, success, decisions |\n| **Part B** — Agent Contract | Agent | Structured — input/output, logic, data model, tests, constraints |\n| **Part C** — Provenance & Review | Both | Living log — authoring history, review trail |\n\n## Part A vs Part B — Decision Rule\n\nIf the content is...\n\n| Content | Part |\n|---|---|\n| WHY this exists, WHAT problem it solves | A.1 Context |\n| WHO uses this, scenario narratives | A.2 Users + Use Cases |\n| Domain invariants in ubiquitous language | A.3 Business Rules |\n| Quantitative success criteria | A.4 Success Criteria |\n| In/out scope with rationale | A.5 Scope |\n| Options + chosen path + tradeoffs | A.6 Key Decisions |\n| Risk table | A.7 Risks |\n| Glossary check | A.9 |\n| Exact dataclass / DTO shape | B.1 Input / B.2 Output |\n| Algorithm / pseudocode | B.3 Core Logic |\n| SQL migrations | B.4 Data Model Changes |\n| BC impact list | B.5 Affected BCs |\n| Domain events with payload | B.6 |\n| HTTP routes (Phase 2+) | B.7 API Surface |\n| Performance / cost / SLO | B.8 NFR |\n| Test pyramid allocation | B.9 Test Requirements |\n| MUST / MUST NOT lists | B.10 Implementation Constraints |\n| Skill / subagent dependencies | B.11 |\n| Feature flag + rollback plan | B.12 Rollout |\n| Pre-merge checklist | B.13 Verification |\n\nIf you can't derive Part B from Part A → Part A is incomplete; revise A first.\n\nSee `references/section-checklists.md` for full section-by-section content lists.\n\n## Stock-Specific Part B Rules\n\n### B.3 — No LLM Math\n\nLogic that produces a number MUST be deterministic code. The LLM only classifies pre-computed values.\n\n```\n# CORRECT\nStep 1: Fetch financial statements (code)\nStep 2: pe = compute_pe(price, eps)               # DETERMINISTIC\nStep 3: LLM classifies pe vs sector range          # CLASSIFICATION ONLY\nStep 4: Combine signal tiers (code aggregation)\n\n# WRONG — VIOLATION (I-S1)\nStep 2: \"LLM computes PE ratio based on context\"\n```\n\n### B.2 — Multi-Criteria Output, Never Single Score\n\n```python\n# CORRECT — multi-criteria\n@dataclass\nclass ThesisOutput:\n    ticker: Ticker\n    bull_case: BullAnalysis\n    bear_case: BearAnalysis              # MUST be substantive\n    quant_signals: QuantSignals\n    sentiment_signals: SentimentSignals\n    recommendation_note: str             # framed as research aid\n    as_of: datetime\n\n# WRONG — single score (charter principle 2 violation)\n@dataclass\nclass ThesisOutput:\n    buy_confidence: float                # ← VIOLATION\n```\n\n## Tier Sizing\n\n| Tier | Lines | Cadence |\n|---|---|---|\n| **Tier 1** Strategic | 100–300 | Rarely changes (e.g., \"Four-Tier Signal Architecture\") |\n| **Tier 2** Feature | 200–500 | Per iteration. Split before shipping if > 500 |\n| **Tier 3** Task | 50–150 | Per session |\n\n## Deriving Part B from Part A — Process\n\nFor each section in Part A, ask:\n1. What does this imply for input/output shape?\n2. What data structures are needed?\n3. What domain events should fire?\n4. What can go wrong (edge cases)?\n5. How will this be tested (pyramid layer)?\n6. Does any number computation appear? → If yes, who computes it? **Must be code, never LLM.**\n\nWork A → B section-by-section. Don't skip step 6.\n\n## Validation Pre-Conditions (Quality Checklist)\n\n- [ ] Every domain term appears in `agent-workspace/ubiquitous-language/glossary.md`\n- [ ] Part A readable by non-engineer stakeholder (no implementation detail)\n- [ ] Every Part B section derives from Part A content\n- [ ] All MUST / MUST NOT constraints listed in B.10\n- [ ] Rollback plan in B.12\n- [ ] Test requirements concrete (not \"write tests\")\n- [ ] Risks identified with mitigation in A.7\n- [ ] Dependencies listed explicitly (A.8 + B.11)\n- [ ] B.3 logic has NO LLM math (numbers come from code)\n- [ ] B.2 output is multi-criteria (not single buy/sell score)\n- [ ] Bear case present and substantive if thesis-related\n\n## Sample Workflow\n\n1. Run `/drill-me` if new domain terms expected (e.g., \"KOL\", \"CredibilityScore\")\n2. Write Part A\n3. Review Part A with user — does it capture intent?\n4. Write Part B (derive from A; no LLM math; multi-criteria)\n5. Review Part B section-by-section\n6. Fill Part C initial authoring history\n7. Save as `specs/tierN/NNN-feature-name.md`\n8. Run `/spec-to-wiki` for Obsidian view\n9. Schedule `/bdd-planner` for test plan\n10. Schedule `/master-plan` for implementation breakdown\n\n## Anti-Patterns\n\n- **Part A too technical** (\"system uses Dramatiq queue...\") → implementation detail goes in B.3 / B.5\n- **Part B too narrative** (\"we'll probably use Pydantic for validation\") → write the actual `@dataclass` shape\n- **Mixing audiences in one section** — split into Part A explanation + Part B contract\n- **Skipping Part C** — provenance log dies first; add at authoring, append at every review\n\nSee `references/section-checklists.md` for full wrong-vs-correct examples.\n\n## See Also\n\n- `references/section-checklists.md` — full Part A.1–A.9 + Part B.1–B.13 content lists + wrong/correct examples\n- `/SPEC_TEMPLATE.md` — canonical template\n- `ddd-tactical-patterns` SKILL.md — domain-model aspects\n- `evidence-extraction` SKILL.md — for specs touching evidence\n- `test-pyramid-balance` SKILL.md — for B.9 test requirements\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":32,"oldLines":35,"newStart":32,"newLines":13,"lines":[" "," ## Part A vs Part B — Decision Rule"," ","-If the content is...","-","-| Content | Part |","+| Content type | Goes in |"," |---|---|","-| WHY this exists, WHAT problem it solves | A.1 Context |","-| WHO uses this, scenario narratives | A.2 Users + Use Cases |","-| Domain invariants in ubiquitous language | A.3 Business Rules |","-| Quantitative success criteria | A.4 Success Criteria |","-| In/out scope with rationale | A.5 Scope |","-| Options + chosen path + tradeoffs | A.6 Key Decisions |","-| Risk table | A.7 Risks |","-| Glossary check | A.9 |","-| Exact dataclass / DTO shape | B.1 Input / B.2 Output |","-| Algorithm / pseudocode | B.3 Core Logic |","-| SQL migrations | B.4 Data Model Changes |","-| BC impact list | B.5 Affected BCs |","-| Domain events with payload | B.6 |","-| HTTP routes (Phase 2+) | B.7 API Surface |","-| Performance / cost / SLO | B.8 NFR |","-| Test pyramid allocation | B.9 Test Requirements |","-| MUST / MUST NOT lists | B.10 Implementation Constraints |","-| Skill / subagent dependencies | B.11 |","-| Feature flag + rollback plan | B.12 Rollout |","-| Pre-merge checklist | B.13 Verification |","+| WHY / WHAT / WHO / scenarios / business rules / scope / key decisions / risks / dependencies | Part A (A.1–A.9) |","+| Exact dataclass / DTO / SQL / BC list / events / API routes / NFR / test plan / MUST-MUST-NOT / rollout / verification | Part B (B.1–B.13) |"," ","-If you can't derive Part B from Part A → Part A is incomplete; revise A first.","+If you can't derive Part B from Part A → Part A is incomplete; revise A first. See `references/section-checklists.md` for the full section-by-section content list."," ","-See `references/section-checklists.md` for full section-by-section content lists.","-"," ## Stock-Specific Part B Rules"," "," ### B.3 — No LLM Math"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"fa22e5f7-6c26-4f5e-9541-1244d1adda2f","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"1691a5a8-8de7-439a-834f-1e05173f2431","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"23d726b5-b342-4a2b-993d-3cf3277c3147","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"skill_listing","content":"- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors (\"from now on when X\", \"each time X\", \"whenever X\", \"before/after X\") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions (\"allow X\", \"add permission\", \"move permission to\"), env vars (\"set X=Y\"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: \"allow npm commands\", \"add bq permission to global settings\", \"move permission to user settings\", \"set DEBUG=true\", \"when claude stops show X\". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.\n- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: \"rebind ctrl+s\", \"add a chord shortcut\", \"change the submit key\", \"customize keybindings\".\n- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.\n- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.\n- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. \"check the deploy every 5 minutes\", \"keep running /babysit-prs\"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.\n- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run (\"run this once at 3pm\", \"remind me to check X tomorrow\").\n- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).\nTRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.\nSKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.\n- ccs-delegation: Auto-activate CCS CLI delegation for deterministic tasks. Parses user input, auto-selects optimal profile (glm/kimi/custom) from ~/.ccs/config.json, enhances prompts with context, executes via `ccs {profile} -p \"task\"` or `ccs {profile}:continue`, and reports results. Triggers on \"use ccs [task]\" patterns, typo/test/refactor keywords. Excludes complex architecture, security-critical code, performance optimization, breaking changes.\n- attach: Port the Claude Code harness layer from this project to a new project directory. Use when bootstrapping a fresh Claude Code project on the same machine, when peers want to copy the harness, or when verifying layer separation via dry-run. Reads .claude/manifest.yaml; copies harness-tagged artifacts only; excludes stockforge biz + personal layers; generates skeleton CLAUDE.md + manifest at target.\n- crawler-reliability: Build reliable web crawlers for data gathering. Use when implementing scrapers for CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz, YouTube (yt-dlp), Facebook fanpages, or any external data source. Covers Python/Playwright patterns, retry/backoff, selector robustness, rate limiting, monitoring.\n- ddd-tactical-patterns: Apply DDD tactical patterns (aggregate, entity, value object, repository, domain event, anti-corruption layer) correctly in Python/dataclasses code. Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\n- decompose-work: Split a non-trivial task into deterministic-vs-LLM portions before execution. Use when planning multi-step work where some sub-tasks are mechanical (file ops, regex, count, schema validation) and others require judgment (synthesis, design, ambiguity resolution). Outputs structured plan that maps each portion to the cheapest competent tool. Pairs with capability-map.md (model × effort × task_class grounding) and try-n-approaches (S9 — Karpathy autoresearch loop).\n- evidence-extraction: Extract structured claims from unstructured sources with citation integrity. Use when building extraction pipelines, parsing news articles or KOL transcripts, or anywhere claims are created from raw data. Ensures every claim has source_url, extracted_at, confidence, and verified attribution. Enforces no-LLM-math invariant (I-S1).\n- fastapi-module: Implement FastAPI routers following StockForge conventions. Use when creating a new HTTP endpoint, adding routes, wiring dependency injection, configuring Pydantic DTOs. Covers router boundaries, provider patterns, testing setup. Phase 2+ only — Phase 1 uses Streamlit dashboard directly.\n- grill-maximization: Doctrine for bundling Q&A questions to the human at maximum density per turn (15-20 target, max 25), so each human-in-the-loop touchpoint is information-rich. Use when composing a Q&A bundle for human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, or when deciding whether to ask one question or wait and bundle. Built on the principle that human-in-the-loop time is the scarcest resource in autonomous coding.\n- obsidian-vault: Search, create, and manage notes in the StockForge Obsidian vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index maintenance. Use when adding content to the knowledge base, navigating entities/concepts, or maintaining the raw/wiki separation. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\n- postgres-pgvector: Design Postgres schemas with pgvector and TimescaleDB for StockForge. Use when creating migrations, designing tables, writing queries. Covers vector embeddings for semantic search on Vietnamese text, time-series for price/sentiment data, JSONB vs structured columns.\n- promote-rule: Cluster agent-notes.md entries by lexical similarity, propose promotion of recurring rules to deterministic hook (priority 1), skill (priority 2), or charter (priority 3). Use when agent-notes has accumulated ≥10 new rules since last promotion run, or on-demand at phase boundary. Outputs proposal markdown to observations/. Pairs with capability-map.md (writes new task_class entries) and decompose-work (consumes promotion outcomes).\n- prompt-engineering: Design and optimize LLM prompts for StockForge pipeline stages. Use when writing or refining prompts for claim extraction, KOL recommendation extraction, sentiment analysis, thesis synthesis. Covers context assembly, prompt caching strategy, budget-aware prompts, structured output. Enforces no-LLM-math constraint.\n- qa-escalation: File-based Q&A protocol — composes bundle file in human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, tracks lifecycle (pending → answered → stale → processed), creates URGENT notification when needed. Use when intent classifier recommends OPEN_QA_BUNDLE / ESCALATE_HUMAN, or grill-maximization has a bundle ready to write. Pairs with grill-maximization (composes content) + Track 5 hooks (auto-move stale).\n- spec-dual-layer: Write specifications with dual-layer structure (business narrative + agent contract). Use when authoring new specs, refining existing specs, or understanding the spec template. Ensures both human stakeholder needs and agent execution needs are served.\n- spec-to-wiki: Convert raw specifications to Obsidian wiki format with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index updates. Use when adding a new spec to the knowledge base, or when regenerating wiki view after spec changes. Maintains raw as source of truth, wiki as navigable view.\n- test-pyramid-balance: Balance unit, integration, and E2E tests properly in Python/pytest. Use when deciding what test to write, reviewing test coverage, or rebalancing skewed test suite. Covers test pyramid shape, BDD vs unit tests, when to use what. Includes stock-domain-specific test categories.\n- try-n-approaches: Karpathy autoresearch outer-loop framing — given a task or signal, generate ≥3 distinct approaches (DEEPEN / BROADEN / ABANDON families), pick one per cheap-first ordering, attach a deterministic metric function (per L-S12-1), and write the experiment frame to learning-data/loop/. Use when an open question surfaces from drift / dogfood / sync-grilling and you need to commit a measurable next step. Pairs with decompose-work (deterministic-vs-LLM split per approach) + capability-map (model × effort grounding) + promote-rule (consumes outcomes).\n- ubiquitous-language: Extract a DDD-style ubiquitous language glossary from the current conversation or domain area. Use when starting work on a new bounded context, when new domain terms emerge, or when verifying consistency between business language and code. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed.\n- user-prompt-intake: Hybrid intent classifier — main session lite-detects trivial prompts, dispatches intent-classifier subagent for complex ones. Use whenever a new user prompt lands (chat or file in human-workspace/user_prompt/) and you need to route the work. Built for full-autonomous loop where every prompt must be classified before action.\n- write-a-skill: Create new Claude Code skills with proper structure, progressive disclosure, and discoverability. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\n---\n\n# Skill: Obsidian Vault Management\n\n## Purpose\n\nMaintain the StockForge Obsidian vault as a navigable knowledge graph for Vietnamese stock market research.\n\n## Core Pattern: Raw vs Wiki\n\n```\nobsidian-vault/\n├── raw/          IMMUTABLE — source materials\n│   └── ...       Agent READS only. Never writes.\n│\n├── wiki/         AGENT-OWNED — knowledge base\n│   ├── _index.md\n│   ├── _log.md\n│   ├── specs/\n│   ├── entities/\n│   ├── concepts/\n│   ├── thesis/\n│   └── synthesis/\n│\n└── CLAUDE.md     Schema & conventions\n```\n\n**Golden rule**: Never write to `raw/`. Ever. If source needs correction, ask human to edit raw/ then re-ingest.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- Adding a new note to vault\n- Converting a spec to wiki format (use `spec-to-wiki` skill)\n- Ingesting a research source into wiki\n- Creating entity/concept stub (company, KOL, market pattern)\n- Updating index after additions\n- Searching for related notes\n\n## When NOT to Use\n\n- Modifying raw/ (never — immutable)\n- Technical docs that belong in repo (use docs/)\n- Session-specific memory (use agent-workspace/memory/)\n\n## Note Types\n\n### Entity Note\nCompany, stock, KOL, market, sector.\n\nPath: `wiki/entities/<slug>.md`\n\nFrontmatter:\n```yaml\n---\ntype: entity\nsubtype: company | kol | stock | market | sector\nstatus: stub | developing | stable\ntickers: [VCB, BID]  # for companies\nsource_mentions:\n  - \"[[SPEC-2026-04-001]]\"\ntags: [entity, vietnam, banking]\ncreated: 2026-04-20\nlast_updated: 2026-04-20\n---\n```\n\n### Concept Note\nFramework, pattern, signal, theory.\n\nPath: `wiki/concepts/<slug>.md`\n\nFrontmatter:\n```yaml\n---\ntype: concept\nstatus: stub | developing | stable\nrelated_concepts:\n  - \"[[concepts/pump-pattern]]\"\n  - \"[[concepts/kol-calibration]]\"\ntags: [concept, signal, vietnam-market]\ncreated: 2026-04-20\n---\n```\n\n### Source Note\nSummary of an ingested source (article, broker report, KOL transcript).\n\nPath: `wiki/sources/<slug>.md`\n\nFrontmatter:\n```yaml\n---\ntype: source\nsource_url: https://cafef.vn/article\nsource_type: article | broker_report | kol_transcript | regulatory_doc\nraw_path: \"../raw/research-sources/article-title.pdf\"\ningested: 2026-04-20\ntickers_mentioned: [VCB, TCB]\ntags: [source, banking, q1-2026]\n---\n```\n\nContent includes key claims extracted, linked to source via raw_path.\n\n### Thesis Note\nInvestment thesis entry.\n\nPath: `wiki/thesis/<YYYY-MM-DD-ticker>.md`\n\nSee `agent-workspace/memory/thesis-log/` for live thesis tracking.\n\n### Synthesis Note\nCross-source analysis, sector overview, pattern analysis.\n\nPath: `wiki/synthesis/<slug>.md`\n\nContent synthesizes multiple sources with citations.\n\n### Spec Note\nWiki view of a source spec.\n\nPath: `wiki/specs/tier<N>-<type>/<spec-id>-<slug>.md`\n\nSee `spec-to-wiki` skill for generation process.\n\n## Wikilink Conventions\n\n### When to Create Wikilink\n\n- First mention of entity/concept in a doc\n- Reference to another spec\n- Reference to bounded context\n- Reference to domain term (from glossary)\n- Reference to a stock ticker\n\n### When NOT to Create Wikilink\n\n- Subsequent mentions in same doc (avoid link pollution)\n- Inside code blocks (plain text)\n- In frontmatter (use `[[...]]` only in specific fields)\n\n### Stub Creation\n\nIf wikilink points to non-existent note → create stub immediately.\n\nStubs are better than missing pages because:\n- Obsidian backlinks still work\n- User can fill in later\n- Search surfaces the term exists\n\n## Index Maintenance\n\n### `wiki/_index.md`\n\nTop-level catalog. Structure:\n\n```markdown\n# Wiki Index\n\n> Auto-maintained. Do not edit manually — use update commands.\n\nLast updated: 2026-04-20\n\n## Specs\n\n### Tier 2 (Feature)\n- [[specs/tier2-feature/SPEC-2026-04-001-validate-investment-thesis]] — Validate Investment Thesis — draft\n\n## Entities\n\n### Companies\n- [[entities/vcb]] — Vietcombank\n- [[entities/tcb]] — Techcombank\n\n### KOLs\n- [[entities/kol-nguyen-van-a]]\n\n### Markets\n- [[entities/vn30]]\n\n## Concepts\n- [[concepts/pump-pattern]]\n- [[concepts/kol-calibration]]\n\n## Thesis Log\nSee [[thesis/]] directory\n\n## Recent Activity\nSee [[_log]]\n```\n\n### `wiki/_log.md`\n\nAppend-only ingestion log.\n\n## Search Patterns\n\n### By Ticker\n```bash\ngrep -rn \"VCB\\|Vietcombank\" wiki/ --include=\"*.md\"\n```\n\n### By Type\nFrontmatter queries (Obsidian Bases):\n```\nTABLE status, created, tickers_mentioned\nFROM \"wiki\"\nWHERE type = \"source\" AND tickers_mentioned\n```\n\n### By Backlink\nOpen any note, see \"Linked mentions\" panel.\n\n## Anti-Patterns\n\n**Don't**:\n- Edit files in `raw/` (violates core pattern)\n- Skip wikilink creation (loses navigability)\n- Create duplicate entity pages (one per company/KOL)\n- Dump long content inline (split into connected notes)\n- Forget to update index/log\n\n**Do**:\n- Aggressive wikilinking (first mention always)\n- Create stubs rather than leave broken links\n- Keep notes focused (one concept per file)\n- Use frontmatter consistently (enables queries)\n- Update index/log every ingest\n\n## Attribution\n\nBase: mattpocock/skills `obsidian-vault` (MIT licensed).\nExtended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy's LLM Wiki gist.\nCustomized for StockForge investment research knowledge management.\n\n## Related Skills\n\n- `spec-to-wiki` — specific workflow for converting specs\n- `write-a-skill` — meta-skill creation\n- `ubiquitous-language` — drives wikilink \"[[concepts/pump-pattern]]\"\n  - \"[[concepts/kol-calibration]]\"\ntags: [concept, signal, vietnam-market]\ncreated: 2026-04-20\n---\n```\n\n### Source Note\nSummary of an ingested source (article, broker report, KOL transcript).\n\nPath: `wiki/sources/<slug>.md`\n\nFrontmatter:\n```yaml\n---\ntype: source\nsource_url: https://cafef.vn/article\nsource_type: article | broker_report | kol_transcript | regulatory_doc\nraw_path: \"../raw/research-sources/article-title.pdf\"\ningested: 2026-04-20\ntickers_mentioned: [VCB, TCB]\ntags: [source, banking, q1-2026]\n---\n```\n\nContent includes key claims extracted, linked to source via raw_path.\n\n### Thesis Note\nInvestment thesis entry.\n\nPath: `wiki/thesis/<YYYY-MM-DD-ticker>.md`\n\nSee `agent-workspace/memory/thesis-log/` for live thesis tracking.\n\n### Synthesis Note\nCross-source analysis, sector overview, pattern analysis.\n\nPath: `wiki/synthesis/<slug>.md`\n\nContent synthesizes multiple sources with citations.\n\n### Spec Note\nWiki view of a source spec.\n\nPath: `wiki/specs/tier<N>-<type>/<spec-id>-<slug>.md`\n\nSee `spec-to-wiki` skill for generation process.\n\n## Wikilink Conventions\n\n### When to Create Wikilink\n\n- First mention of entity/concept in a doc\n- Reference to another spec\n- Reference to bounded context\n- Reference to domain term (from glossary)\n- Reference to a stock ticker\n\n### When NOT to Create Wikilink\n\n- Subsequent mentions in same doc (avoid link pollution)\n- Inside code blocks (plain text)\n- In frontmatter (use `[[...]]` only in specific fields)\n\n### Stub Creation\n\nIf wikilink points to non-existent note → create stub immediately.\n\nStubs are better than missing pages because:\n- Obsidian backlinks still work\n- User can fill in later\n- Search surfaces the term exists\n\n## Index Maintenance\n\n### `wiki/_index.md`\n\nTop-level catalog. Structure:\n\n```markdown\n# Wiki Index\n\n> Auto-maintained. Do not edit manually — use update commands.\n\nLast updated: 2026-04-20\n\n## Specs\n\n### Tier 2 (Feature)\n- [[specs/tier2-feature/SPEC-2026-04-001-validate-investment-thesis]] — Validate Investment Thesis — draft\n\n## Entities\n\n### Companies\n- [[entities/vcb]] — Vietcombank\n- [[entities/tcb]] — Techcombank\n\n### KOLs\n- [[entities/kol-nguyen-van-a]]\n\n### Markets\n- [[entities/vn30]]\n\n## Concepts\n- [[concepts/pump-pattern]]\n- [[concepts/kol-calibration]]\n\n## Thesis Log\nSee [[thesis/]] directory\n\n## Recent Activity\nSee [[_log]]\n```\n\n### `wiki/_log.md`\n\nAppend-only ingestion log.\n\n## Search Patterns\n\n### By Ticker\n```bash\ngrep -rn \"VCB\\|Vietcombank\" wiki/ --include=\"*.md\"\n```\n\n### By Type\nFrontmatter queries (Obsidian Bases):\n```\nTABLE status, created, tickers_mentioned\nFROM \"wiki\"\nWHERE type = \"source\" AND tickers_mentioned\n```\n\n### By Backlink\nOpen any note, see \"Linked mentions\" panel.\n\n## Anti-Patterns\n\n**Don't**:\n- Edit files in `raw/` (violates core pattern)\n- Skip wikilink creation (loses navigability)\n- Create duplicate entity pages (one per company/KOL)\n- Dump long content inline (split into connected notes)\n- Forget to update index/log\n\n**Do**:\n- Aggressive wikilinking (first mention always)\n- Create stubs rather than leave broken links\n- Keep notes focused (one concept per file)\n- Use frontmatter consistently (enables queries)\n- Update index/log every ingest\n\n## Attribution\n\nBase: mattpocock/skills `obsidian-vault` (MIT licensed).\nExtended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy's LLM Wiki gist.\nCustomized for StockForge investment research knowledge management.\n\n## Related Skills\n\n- `spec-to-wiki` — specific workflow for converting specs\n- `write-a-skill` — meta-skill creation\n- `ubiquitous-language` — drives wikilink Examples: \"allow npm commands\", \"add bq permission to global settings\", \"move permission to user settings\", \"set DEBUG=true\", \"when claude stops show X\". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.\n- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Triggers on \"use ccs [task]\" patterns, typo/test/refactor keywords. Excludes complex architecture, security-critical code, performance optimization, breaking changes.\n- attach: Port the Claude Code harness layer from this project to a new project directory. Covers Python/Playwright patterns, retry/backoff, selector robustness, rate limiting, monitoring.\n- ddd-tactical-patterns: Apply DDD tactical patterns (aggregate, entity, value object, repository, domain event, anti-corruption layer) correctly in Python/dataclasses code. Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\n- decompose-work: Split a non-trivial task into deterministic-vs-LLM portions before execution. Use when planning multi-step work where some sub-tasks are mechanical (file ops, regex, count, schema validation) and others require judgment (synthesis, design, ambiguity resolution). Outputs structured plan that maps each portion to the cheapest competent tool. Pairs with capability-map.md (model × effort × task_class grounding) and try-n-approaches (S9 — Karpathy autoresearch loop).\n- evidence-extraction: Extract structured claims from unstructured sources with citation integrity. Use when building extraction pipelines, parsing news articles or KOL transcripts, or anywhere claims are created from raw data. Ensures every claim has source_url, extracted_at, confidence, and verified attribution. Enforces no-LLM-math invariant (I-S1).\n- fastapi-module: Implement FastAPI routers following StockForge conventions. Use when creating a new HTTP endpoint, adding routes, wiring dependency injection, configuring Pydantic DTOs. Covers router boundaries, provider patterns, testing setup. Phase 2+ only — Phase 1 uses Streamlit dashboard directly.\n- grill-maximization: Doctrine for bundling Q&A questions to the human at maximum density per turn (15-20 target, max 25), so each human-in-the-loop touchpoint is information-rich. Use when composing a Q&A bundle for human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, or when deciding whether to ask one question or wait and bundle. Built on the principle that human-in-the-loop time is the scarcest resource in autonomous coding.\n- obsidian-vault: Search, create, and manage notes in the StockForge Obsidian vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index maintenance. Use when adding content to the knowledge base, navigating entities/concepts, or maintaining the raw/wiki separation. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\n- postgres-pgvector: Design Postgres schemas with pgvector and TimescaleDB for StockForge. Use when creating migrations, designing tables, writing queries. Covers vector embeddings for semantic search on Vietnamese text, time-series for price/sentiment data, JSONB vs structured columns.\n- promote-rule: Cluster agent-notes.md entries by lexical similarity, propose promotion of recurring rules to deterministic hook (priority 1), skill (priority 2), or charter (priority 3). Use when agent-notes has accumulated ≥10 new rules since last promotion run, or on-demand at phase boundary. Outputs proposal markdown to observations/. Pairs with capability-map.md (writes new task_class entries) and decompose-work (consumes promotion outcomes).\n- prompt-engineering: Design and optimize LLM prompts for StockForge pipeline stages. Use when writing or refining prompts for claim extraction, KOL recommendation extraction, sentiment analysis, thesis synthesis. Covers context assembly, prompt caching strategy, budget-aware prompts, structured output. Enforces no-LLM-math constraint.\n- qa-escalation: File-based Q&A protocol — composes bundle file in human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, tracks lifecycle (pending → answered → stale → processed), creates URGENT notification when needed. Use when intent classifier recommends OPEN_QA_BUNDLE / ESCALATE_HUMAN, or grill-maximization has a bundle ready to write. Pairs with grill-maximization (composes content) + Track 5 hooks (auto-move stale).\n- spec-dual-layer: Write specifications with dual-layer structure (business narrative + agent contract). Ensures both human stakeholder needs and agent execution needs are served.\n- spec-to-wiki: Convert raw specifications to Obsidian wiki format with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index updates. Use when adding a new spec to the knowledge base, or when regenerating wiki view after spec changes. Maintains raw as source of truth, wiki as navigable view.\n- test-pyramid-balance: Balance unit, integration, and E2E tests properly in Python/pytest. Use when an open question surfaces from drift / dogfood / sync-grilling and you need to commit a measurable next step. {"parentUuid":"9327a4c7-7e5c-4a67-ac62-06f3f161f829","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_01FVCSqeNawbijfprckwA47m","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Uhs6YJF1qJn1jJbCMv3bUi","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\.claude\\skills\\obsidian-vault\\SKILL.md","content":"---\nname: obsidian-vault\ndescription: Search, create, and manage notes in the StockForge Obsidian vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index maintenance. Use when adding content to the knowledge base, navigating entities/concepts, or maintaining the raw/wiki separation. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\nallowed-tools: [Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Edit, Write]\n---\n\n# Skill: Obsidian Vault Management\n\n## Purpose\n\nMaintain `obsidian-vault/` as a navigable knowledge graph for Vietnamese stock market research.\n\n## Core Pattern: Raw vs Wiki\n\n```\nobsidian-vault/\n├── raw/          IMMUTABLE — source materials. Agent READS only. Never writes.\n├── wiki/         AGENT-OWNED — knowledge base\n│   ├── _index.md, _log.md\n│   ├── specs/, entities/, concepts/, sources/, thesis/, synthesis/\n└── CLAUDE.md     Schema & conventions\n```\n\n**Golden rule**: Never write to `raw/`. Ever. If source needs correction, ask human to edit raw/ then re-ingest. Hard-enforced via `.claude/settings.json` deny rule.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- Adding a new note to vault\n- Converting a spec to wiki format (use `spec-to-wiki` skill)\n- Ingesting a research source into wiki\n- Creating entity / concept stub (company, KOL, market pattern)\n- Updating index after additions\n\n## When NOT to Use\n\n- Modifying `raw/` (never — immutable)\n- Technical / engineering docs (use `docs/` at repo root)\n- Session-specific memory (use `agent-workspace/memory/`)\n\n## Note Types\n\n| Type | Path | Used for |\n|---|---|---|\n| **Entity** | `wiki/entities/<slug>.md` | Company, stock, KOL, market, sector |\n| **Concept** | `wiki/concepts/<slug>.md` | Framework, pattern, signal, theory |\n| **Source** | `wiki/sources/<slug>.md` | Summary of ingested article / report / KOL transcript (links to `raw/` via `raw_path`) |\n| **Thesis** | `wiki/thesis/<YYYY-MM-DD-ticker>.md` | Investment thesis entry (live tracking in `agent-workspace/memory/thesis-log/`) |\n| **Synthesis** | `wiki/synthesis/<slug>.md` | Cross-source analysis, sector overview, pattern analysis |\n| **Spec** | `wiki/specs/tier<N>-<type>/<spec-id>-<slug>.md` | Wiki view of a spec (use `spec-to-wiki` skill) |\n\nFrontmatter templates for all six in `references/note-templates.md`.\n\n## Wikilink Rules\n\n### Create wikilink when\n\n- First mention of an entity / concept in a doc\n- Reference to another spec, BC, or domain term (from glossary)\n- Reference to a stock ticker\n\n### Don't create when\n\n- Subsequent mentions in same doc (avoid pollution)\n- Inside code blocks (plain text)\n- In frontmatter (only specific list-typed fields like `source_mentions`, `related_concepts`)\n\n### Stub creation\n\nIf a wikilink points to a non-existent note → create a stub immediately. Stubs preserve backlinks and let search surface that the term exists. Better than missing pages.\n\n## Index Maintenance\n\n`wiki/_index.md` is the top-level catalog. Append to relevant section every ingest. Keep it tidy — agent updates, human reads.\n\n`wiki/_log.md` is append-only ingestion log: timestamp + note path + 1-line summary per add.\n\nFull `_index.md` skeleton + structure in `references/note-templates.md` § Index template.\n\n## Search Patterns\n\n| Goal | Tool |\n|---|---|\n| By ticker | `Grep \"VCB\\|Vietcombank\" wiki/ --type md` |\n| By type / status | Obsidian Bases query on `type:` + `status:` frontmatter |\n| Backlinks | Open note in Obsidian → \"Linked mentions\" panel |\n\n## Validation Pre-Conditions\n\n- Target path is under `wiki/`, NEVER `raw/`\n- Frontmatter has `type:` field matching note type table\n- `created:` and `last_updated:` are ISO dates\n- Every wikilink target either exists or is created as a stub in the same operation\n- `wiki/_index.md` updated for first-of-kind notes\n- `wiki/_log.md` appended on every ingest\n\n## Anti-Patterns\n\n**Don't**:\n- Edit `raw/` (violates core pattern + harness deny rule)\n- Skip wikilink creation (loses navigability)\n- Create duplicate entity pages (one per company / KOL)\n- Dump long content inline (split into connected notes)\n- Forget to update index / log\n\n**Do**:\n- Aggressive wikilinking on first mention\n- Create stubs rather than leave broken links\n- Keep notes focused (one concept per file)\n- Use frontmatter consistently (enables Obsidian Bases queries)\n- Update index + log every ingest\n\n## Smoke Test\n\nFor task \"ingest a CafeF article on VCB Q1 2026 earnings\":\n\nExpected output:\n- Create `wiki/sources/2026-04-vcb-q1-earnings-cafef.md` with frontmatter (`type: source`, `source_url`, `raw_path`, `tickers_mentioned: [VCB]`)\n- Reference `[[entities/vcb]]` in body — if missing, create stub\n- Append to `wiki/_index.md § Sources` and `wiki/_log.md`\n- Source body extracts key claims with quotes; numbers come from article verbatim (I-S2)\n- Never edit `raw/research-sources/2026-04-vcb-q1-earnings.pdf`\n\nIf the proposal touches `raw/`, suggests an LLM-summarized number, or skips wikilink/index update → reject.\n\n## Attribution\n\nBase: `mattpocock/skills` `obsidian-vault` (MIT licensed). Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy's LLM Wiki gist. Customized for StockForge investment research.\n\n## See Also\n\n- `references/note-templates.md` — full frontmatter blocks per type + index template + search examples\n- `spec-to-wiki` SKILL.md — workflow for converting specs to wiki notes\n- `ubiquitous-language` SKILL.md — drives wikilink candidates from glossary\n- `obsidian-vault/CLAUDE.md` — vault-local schema rules\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":7090,"cache_read_input_tokens":270968,"output_tokens":4329,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":7090,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":4329,"cache_read_input_tokens":270968,"cache_creation_input_tokens":7090,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":7090},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CaYFf6zjniabqpqCHdmub","type":"assistant","uuid":"058de7fd-b656-4d71-9c8a-bbb6cde0d0b4","timestamp":"2026-04-29T14:53:49.417Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"1691a5a8-8de7-439a-834f-1e05173f2431","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

Customized for StockForge investment research."," ","-## Related Skills","+## See Also"," ","-- `spec-to-wiki` — specific workflow for converting specs","-- `write-a-skill` — meta-skill creation","-- `ubiquitous-language` — drives wikilink candidates","+- `references/note-templates.md` — full frontmatter blocks per type + index template + search examples","+- `spec-to-wiki` SKILL.md — workflow for converting specs to wiki notes","+- `ubiquitous-language` SKILL.md — drives wikilink candidates from glossary","+- `obsidian-vault/CLAUDE.md` — vault-local schema rules"]}],"originalFile":"---\nname: obsidian-vault\ndescription: Search, create, and manage notes in the StockForge Obsidian vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index maintenance. Use when adding content to the knowledge base, navigating entities/concepts, or maintaining the raw/wiki separation. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\n---\n\n# Skill: Obsidian Vault Management\n\n## Purpose\n\nMaintain the StockForge Obsidian vault as a navigable knowledge graph for Vietnamese stock market research.\n\n## Core Pattern: Raw vs Wiki\n\n```\nobsidian-vault/\n├── raw/          IMMUTABLE — source materials\n│   └── ...       Agent READS only. Never writes.\n│\n├── wiki/         AGENT-OWNED — knowledge base\n│   ├── _index.md\n│   ├── _log.md\n│   ├── specs/\n│   ├── entities/\n│   ├── concepts/\n│   ├── thesis/\n│   └── synthesis/\n│\n└── CLAUDE.md     Schema & conventions\n```\n\n**Golden rule**: Never write to `raw/`. Ever. If source needs correction, ask human to edit raw/ then re-ingest.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- Adding a new note to vault\n- Converting a spec to wiki format (use `spec-to-wiki` skill)\n- Ingesting a research source into wiki\n- Creating entity/concept stub (company, KOL, market pattern)\n- Updating index after additions\n- Searching for related notes\n\n## When NOT to Use\n\n- Modifying raw/ (never — immutable)\n- Technical docs that belong in repo (use docs/)\n- Session-specific memory (use agent-workspace/memory/)\n\n## Note Types\n\n### Entity Note\nCompany, stock, KOL, market, sector.\n\nPath: `wiki/entities/<slug>.md`\n\nFrontmatter:\n```yaml\n---\ntype: entity\nsubtype: company | kol | stock | market | sector\nstatus: stub | developing | stable\ntickers: [VCB, BID]  # for companies\nsource_mentions:\n  - \"[[SPEC-2026-04-001]]\"\ntags: [entity, vietnam, banking]\ncreated: 2026-04-20\nlast_updated: 2026-04-20\n---\n```\n\n### Concept Note\nFramework, pattern, signal, theory.\n\nPath: `wiki/concepts/<slug>.md`\n\nFrontmatter:\n```yaml\n---\ntype: concept\nstatus: stub | developing | stable\nrelated_concepts:\n  - \"[[concepts/pump-pattern]]\"\n  - \"[[concepts/kol-calibration]]\"\ntags: [concept, signal, vietnam-market]\ncreated: 2026-04-20\n---\n```\n\n### Source Note\nSummary of an ingested source (article, broker report, KOL transcript).\n\nPath: `wiki/sources/<slug>.md`\n\nFrontmatter:\n```yaml\n---\ntype: source\nsource_url: https://cafef.vn/article\nsource_type: article | broker_report | kol_transcript | regulatory_doc\nraw_path: \"../raw/research-sources/article-title.pdf\"\ningested: 2026-04-20\ntickers_mentioned: [VCB, TCB]\ntags: [source, banking, q1-2026]\n---\n```\n\nContent includes key claims extracted, linked to source via raw_path.\n\n### Thesis Note\nInvestment thesis entry.\n\nPath: `wiki/thesis/<YYYY-MM-DD-ticker>.md`\n\nSee `agent-workspace/memory/thesis-log/` for live thesis tracking.\n\n### Synthesis Note\nCross-source analysis, sector overview, pattern analysis.\n\nPath: `wiki/synthesis/<slug>.md`\n\nContent synthesizes multiple sources with citations.\n\n### Spec Note\nWiki view of a source spec.\n\nPath: `wiki/specs/tier<N>-<type>/<spec-id>-<slug>.md`\n\nSee `spec-to-wiki` skill for generation process.\n\n## Wikilink Conventions\n\n### When to Create Wikilink\n\n- First mention of entity/concept in a doc\n- Reference to another spec\n- Reference to bounded context\n- Reference to domain term (from glossary)\n- Reference to a stock ticker\n\n### When NOT to Create Wikilink\n\n- Subsequent mentions in same doc (avoid link pollution)\n- Inside code blocks (plain text)\n- In frontmatter (use `[[...]]` only in specific fields)\n\n### Stub Creation\n\nIf wikilink points to non-existent note → create stub immediately.\n\nStubs are better than missing pages because:\n- Obsidian backlinks still work\n- User can fill in later\n- Search surfaces the term exists\n\n## Index Maintenance\n\n### `wiki/_index.md`\n\nTop-level catalog. Structure:\n\n```markdown\n# Wiki Index\n\n> Auto-maintained. Do not edit manually — use update commands.\n\nLast updated: 2026-04-20\n\n## Specs\n\n### Tier 2 (Feature)\n- [[specs/tier2-feature/SPEC-2026-04-001-validate-investment-thesis]] — Validate Investment Thesis — draft\n\n## Entities\n\n### Companies\n- [[entities/vcb]] — Vietcombank\n- [[entities/tcb]] — Techcombank\n\n### KOLs\n- [[entities/kol-nguyen-van-a]]\n\n### Markets\n- [[entities/vn30]]\n\n## Concepts\n- [[concepts/pump-pattern]]\n- [[concepts/kol-calibration]]\n\n## Thesis Log\nSee [[thesis/]] directory\n\n## Recent Activity\nSee [[_log]]\n```\n\n### `wiki/_log.md`\n\nAppend-only ingestion log.\n\n## Search Patterns\n\n### By Ticker\n```bash\ngrep -rn \"VCB\\|Vietcombank\" wiki/ --include=\"*.md\"\n```\n\n### By Type\nFrontmatter queries (Obsidian Bases):\n```\nTABLE status, created, tickers_mentioned\nFROM \"wiki\"\nWHERE type = \"source\" AND tickers_mentioned\n```\n\n### By Backlink\nOpen any note, see \"Linked mentions\" panel.\n\n## Anti-Patterns\n\n**Don't**:\n- Edit files in `raw/` (violates core pattern)\n- Skip wikilink creation (loses navigability)\n- Create duplicate entity pages (one per company/KOL)\n- Dump long content inline (split into connected notes)\n- Forget to update index/log\n\n**Do**:\n- Aggressive wikilinking (first mention always)\n- Create stubs rather than leave broken links\n- Keep notes focused (one concept per file)\n- Use frontmatter consistently (enables queries)\n- Update index/log every ingest\n\n## Attribution\n\nBase: mattpocock/skills `obsidian-vault` (MIT licensed).\nExtended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy's LLM Wiki gist.\nCustomized for StockForge investment research knowledge management.\n\n## Related Skills\n\n- `spec-to-wiki` — specific workflow for converting specs\n- `write-a-skill` — meta-skill creation\n- `ubiquitous-language` — drives wikilink candidates\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"058de7fd-b656-4d71-9c8a-bbb6cde0d0b4","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"1691a5a8-8de7-439a-834f-1e05173f2431","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"e2d81c34-173a-4bbf-bd67-a707a6a94db5","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"skill_listing","content":"- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors (\"from now on when X\", \"each time X\", \"whenever X\", \"before/after X\") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions (\"allow X\", \"add permission\", \"move permission to\"), env vars (\"set X=Y\"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: \"allow npm commands\", \"add bq permission to global settings\", \"move permission to user settings\", \"set DEBUG=true\", \"when claude stops show X\". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.\n- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: \"rebind ctrl+s\", \"add a chord shortcut\", \"change the submit key\", \"customize keybindings\".\n- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.\n- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.\n- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. \"check the deploy every 5 minutes\", \"keep running /babysit-prs\"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.\n- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run (\"run this once at 3pm\", \"remind me to check X tomorrow\").\n- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).\nTRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.\nSKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.\n- ccs-delegation: Auto-activate CCS CLI delegation for deterministic tasks. Parses user input, auto-selects optimal profile (glm/kimi/custom) from ~/.ccs/config.json, enhances prompts with context, executes via `ccs {profile} -p \"task\"` or `ccs {profile}:continue`, and reports results. Triggers on \"use ccs [task]\" patterns, typo/test/refactor keywords. Excludes complex architecture, security-critical code, performance optimization, breaking changes.\n- attach: Port the Claude Code harness layer from this project to a new project directory. Use when bootstrapping a fresh Claude Code project on the same machine, when peers want to copy the harness, or when verifying layer separation via dry-run. Reads .claude/manifest.yaml; copies harness-tagged artifacts only; excludes stockforge biz + personal layers; generates skeleton CLAUDE.md + manifest at target.\n- crawler-reliability: Build reliable web crawlers for data gathering. Use when implementing scrapers for CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz, YouTube (yt-dlp), Facebook fanpages, or any external data source. Covers Python/Playwright patterns, retry/backoff, selector robustness, rate limiting, monitoring.\n- ddd-tactical-patterns: Apply DDD tactical patterns (aggregate, entity, value object, repository, domain event, anti-corruption layer) correctly in Python/dataclasses code. Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\n- decompose-work: Split a non-trivial task into deterministic-vs-LLM portions before execution. Use when planning multi-step work where some sub-tasks are mechanical (file ops, regex, count, schema validation) and others require judgment (synthesis, design, ambiguity resolution). Outputs structured plan that maps each portion to the cheapest competent tool. Pairs with capability-map.md (model × effort × task_class grounding) and try-n-approaches (S9 — Karpathy autoresearch loop).\n- evidence-extraction: Extract structured claims from unstructured sources with citation integrity. Use when building extraction pipelines, parsing news articles or KOL transcripts, or anywhere claims are created from raw data. Ensures every claim has source_url, extracted_at, confidence, and verified attribution. Enforces no-LLM-math invariant (I-S1).\n- fastapi-module: Implement FastAPI routers following StockForge conventions. Use when creating a new HTTP endpoint, adding routes, wiring dependency injection, configuring Pydantic DTOs. Covers router boundaries, provider patterns, testing setup. Phase 2+ only — Phase 1 uses Streamlit dashboard directly.\n- grill-maximization: Doctrine for bundling Q&A questions to the human at maximum density per turn (15-20 target, max 25), so each human-in-the-loop touchpoint is information-rich. Use when composing a Q&A bundle for human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, or when deciding whether to ask one question or wait and bundle. Built on the principle that human-in-the-loop time is the scarcest resource in autonomous coding.\n- obsidian-vault: Search, create, and manage notes in the StockForge Obsidian vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index maintenance. Use when adding content to the knowledge base, navigating entities/concepts, or maintaining the raw/wiki separation. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\n- postgres-pgvector: Design Postgres schemas with pgvector and TimescaleDB for StockForge. Use when creating migrations, designing tables, writing queries. Covers vector embeddings for semantic search on Vietnamese text, time-series for price/sentiment data, JSONB vs structured columns.\n- promote-rule: Cluster agent-notes.md entries by lexical similarity, propose promotion of recurring rules to deterministic hook (priority 1), skill (priority 2), or charter (priority 3). Use when agent-notes has accumulated ≥10 new rules since last promotion run, or on-demand at phase boundary. Outputs proposal markdown to observations/. Pairs with capability-map.md (writes new task_class entries) and decompose-work (consumes promotion outcomes).\n- prompt-engineering: Design and optimize LLM prompts for StockForge pipeline stages. Use when writing or refining prompts for claim extraction, KOL recommendation extraction, sentiment analysis, thesis synthesis. Covers context assembly, prompt caching strategy, budget-aware prompts, structured output. Enforces no-LLM-math constraint.\n- qa-escalation: File-based Q&A protocol — composes bundle file in human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, tracks lifecycle (pending → answered → stale → processed), creates URGENT notification when needed. Use when intent classifier recommends OPEN_QA_BUNDLE / ESCALATE_HUMAN, or grill-maximization has a bundle ready to write. Pairs with grill-maximization (composes content) + Track 5 hooks (auto-move stale).\n- spec-dual-layer: Write specifications with dual-layer structure (business narrative + agent contract). Use when authoring new specs, refining existing specs, or understanding the spec template. Ensures both human stakeholder needs and agent execution needs are served.\n- spec-to-wiki: Convert raw specifications to Obsidian wiki format with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index updates. Use when adding a new spec to the knowledge base, or when regenerating wiki view after spec changes. Maintains raw as source of truth, wiki as navigable view.\n- test-pyramid-balance: Balance unit, integration, and E2E tests properly in Python/pytest. Use when deciding what test to write, reviewing test coverage, or rebalancing skewed test suite. Covers test pyramid shape, BDD vs unit tests, when to use what. Includes stock-domain-specific test categories.\n- try-n-approaches: Karpathy autoresearch outer-loop framing — given a task or signal, generate ≥3 distinct approaches (DEEPEN / BROADEN / ABANDON families), pick one per cheap-first ordering, attach a deterministic metric function (per L-S12-1), and write the experiment frame to learning-data/loop/. Use when an open question surfaces from drift / dogfood / sync-grilling and you need to commit a measurable next step. Pairs with decompose-work (deterministic-vs-LLM split per approach) + capability-map (model × effort grounding) + promote-rule (consumes outcomes).\n- ubiquitous-language: Extract a DDD-style ubiquitous language glossary from the current conversation or domain area. Use when starting work on a new bounded context, when new domain terms emerge, or when verifying consistency between business language and code. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed.\n- user-prompt-intake: Hybrid intent classifier — main session lite-detects trivial prompts, dispatches intent-classifier subagent for complex ones. Use whenever a new user prompt lands (chat or file in human-workspace/user_prompt/) and you need to route the work. Built for full-autonomous loop where every prompt must be classified before action.\n- write-a-skill: Create new Claude Code skills with proper structure, progressive disclosure, and discoverability. Use when extracting a pattern from multiple sessions into a reusable skill, or when user asks to formalize a technique. {"parentUuid":"31a669d5-0e45-4421-a16b-b20e24d04369","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"9500d654-bd35-4293-b673-30266423655a","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01SjSxXv71XVvc64BQnsSWXu","type":"tool_result","content":"# /spec-to-wiki — Convert Raw Spec to Obsidian Wiki Format\n\n> Transform raw spec (source format) to Obsidian-optimized wiki entry with wikilinks and frontmatter.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- After `/spec-author` creates a spec\n- When spec changes significantly (regenerate wiki view)\n- When retrofitting existing specs into wiki\n\n## Input\n\n`$ARGUMENTS` — path to raw spec file (e.g., `specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis.md`)\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Read Raw Spec\n\nRead the source spec completely.\nParse structure (Part A / B / C).\n\n### 2. Identify Entities for Linking\n\nScan for:\n- Domain terms from glossary (will become `[[term]]` links)\n- References to other specs (SPEC-YYYY-MM-NNN)\n- Bounded contexts\n- Key concepts\n- Company names, tickers, markets mentioned\n\nFor each mention, determine:\n- Is there existing wiki entry at `obsidian-vault/wiki/entities/` or `obsidian-vault/wiki/concepts/`?\n- If not, create stub page\n\n### 3. Generate Wiki Version\n\nTarget path: `obsidian-vault/wiki/specs/tier2-feature/NNN-feature-name.md`\n\nStructure:\n```markdown\n---\ntype: spec\ntier: 2\nspec_id: SPEC-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN\nstatus: draft | review | approved | implemented | deprecated\nversion: 1.0\ncreated: YYYY-MM-DD\nlast_reviewed: YYYY-MM-DD\nbounded_contexts: [list with [[wiki links]]]\nrelated_specs: [list of spec_ids as wikilinks]\nubiquitous_language_terms: [list with [[wiki links]]]\nsource: [[specs/tier2-feature/NNN-feature-name-raw]]\ntags: [feature, tier2, <domain>]\n---\n\n# [[NNN Feature Name]]\n\n> Wiki view of [[SPEC-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN]]. Raw source: [source file](../../../specs/tier2-feature/NNN-feature-name.md).\n\n## Quick Navigation\n\n- [[#Part A — Business Specification]]\n- [[#Part B — Agent Contract]]\n- [[#Part C — Provenance & Review]]\n\n## Related\n- Depends on: [list with wikilinks]\n- Enables: [list with wikilinks]\n- Affects bounded contexts: [wikilinks to BC pages]\n\n---\n\n[Full content of raw spec, but with:\n - All glossary terms replaced with [[term]] wikilinks\n - All entity mentions wikilinked\n - All cross-spec references wikilinked\n - Frontmatter enriched\n]\n```\n\n### 4. Create Missing Stubs\n\nFor entities/concepts mentioned but lacking wiki page:\n\nCreate stub at `obsidian-vault/wiki/entities/<entity-name>.md` or `concepts/<concept-name>.md`:\n\n```markdown\n---\ntype: entity | concept\nstatus: stub\nmentioned_in: [[spec-where-first-mentioned]]\ncreated: YYYY-MM-DD\ntags: [stub]\n---\n\n# [[Entity/Concept Name]]\n\n> Stub page. Created from mention in [[spec-id]]. Please expand.\n\n## Brief Context\n[From where it was mentioned]\n\n## To Add\n- Full definition\n- Properties\n- Relationships\n- Relevant claims\n\n## Backlinks\n[Obsidian auto-populates]\n```\n\n### 5. Update Index\n\nUpdate `obsidian-vault/wiki/_index.md`:\n\n```markdown\n# Wiki Index\n\n> Catalog of all wiki content. Auto-maintained.\n\n## Specs\n### Tier 2 (Feature)\n- [[specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis]] — Validate Investment Thesis — status: draft — 2026-04-20\n\n## Entities\n- [[entities/vcb]]\n- [[entities/vn30]]\n- ...\n\n## Concepts\n- [[concepts/pump-pattern]]\n- [[concepts/bounded-context]]\n- ...\n\n## Recent Activity\nSee [[_log]]\n```\n\n### 6. Append to Log\n\nAppend to `obsidian-vault/wiki/_log.md`:\n\n```markdown\n## [YYYY-MM-DD] ingest | SPEC-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN\n\n**Type**: spec (tier 2)\n**Source**: `specs/tier2-feature/NNN-feature-name.md`\n**Wiki entry**: `specs/tier2-feature/NNN-feature-name.md`\n**Entities created**: [list]\n**Stubs created**: [list]\n**Links added**: N inbound, M outbound\n```\n\n### 7. Diff-Mode for Updates\n\nIf wiki version already exists (re-run):\n- Diff raw vs previous wiki version\n- Preserve existing wikilinks (don't replace with re-resolution)\n- Add new sections\n- Update metadata\n\nDo not blindly overwrite — may lose human-added connections.\n\n### 8. Output Report\n\n```markdown\n# Spec Converted to Wiki\n\n## Source\n[raw spec path]\n\n## Wiki Version Created\n[wiki path]\n\n## Entities Linked\n- [[term1]] — existing\n- [[term2]] — existing\n- [[term3]] — new stub created\n- ...\n\n## Stubs Created\n- `entities/new-term.md`\n- `concepts/new-concept.md`\n\n## Index Updated\nAdded entry for this spec.\n\n## Log Appended\nSee `wiki/_log.md` latest entry.\n\n## Next Steps\n1. Open Obsidian vault, navigate to new spec\n2. Review linkages in graph view\n3. Expand any stub pages that are important\n4. Connect to related concepts if not auto-linked\n```\n\n---\n\n## Wiki vs Raw — When to Edit Which\n\n**Edit raw spec when**:\n- Content changes\n- Business rules update\n- New decisions made\n- Version bump\n\n**Edit wiki when**:\n- Adding wikilinks agent missed\n- Adding cross-references\n- Enriching with connections found during use\n- Updating status\n\n**Regenerate wiki from raw when**:\n- Raw spec significantly changed\n- Want clean state\n\n---\n\n## Anti-Patterns\n\n**Don't**:\n- Overwrite wiki version without diff check (loses human additions)\n- Create wikilinks to non-existent concepts (create stubs first)\n- Skip frontmatter (breaks Obsidian queries)\n- Duplicate content between raw and wiki (raw is source)\n\n**Do**:\n- Use wikilinks liberally for discoverability\n- Create stubs proactively (better to have empty stub than missing page)\n- Keep frontmatter consistent with schema\n- Update _index.md and _log.md every ingest","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"cabbd0dd-20ca-4671-9d0b-eab8fd012ffb","timestamp":"2026-04-29T14:54:15.955Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"# /spec-to-wiki — Convert Raw Spec to Obsidian Wiki Format\n\n> Transform raw spec (source format) to Obsidian-optimized wiki entry with wikilinks and frontmatter.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- After `/spec-author` creates a spec\n- When spec changes significantly (regenerate wiki view)\n- When retrofitting existing specs into wiki\n\n## Input\n\n`$ARGUMENTS` — path to raw spec file (e.g., `specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis.md`)\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Read Raw Spec\n\nRead the source spec completely.\nParse structure (Part A / B / C).\n\n### 2. Identify Entities for Linking\n\nScan for:\n- Domain terms from glossary (will become `[[term]]` links)\n- References to other specs (SPEC-YYYY-MM-NNN)\n- Bounded contexts\n- Key concepts\n- Company names, tickers, markets mentioned\n\nFor each mention, determine:\n- Is there existing wiki entry at `obsidian-vault/wiki/entities/` or `obsidian-vault/wiki/concepts/`?\n- If not, create stub page\n\n### 3. Generate Wiki Version\n\nTarget path: `obsidian-vault/wiki/specs/tier2-feature/NNN-feature-name.md`\n\nStructure:\n```markdown\n---\ntype: spec\ntier: 2\nspec_id: SPEC-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN\nstatus: draft | review | approved | implemented | deprecated\nversion: 1.0\ncreated: YYYY-MM-DD\nlast_reviewed: YYYY-MM-DD\nbounded_contexts: [list with [[wiki links]]]\nrelated_specs: [list of spec_ids as wikilinks]\nubiquitous_language_terms: [list with [[wiki links]]]\nsource: [[specs/tier2-feature/NNN-feature-name-raw]]\ntags: [feature, tier2, <domain>]\n---\n\n# [[NNN Feature Name]]\n\n> Wiki view of [[SPEC-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN]]. Raw source: [source file](../../../specs/tier2-feature/NNN-feature-name.md).\n\n## Quick Navigation\n\n- [[#Part A — Business Specification]]\n- [[#Part B — Agent Contract]]\n- [[#Part C — Provenance & Review]]\n\n## Related\n- Depends on: [list with wikilinks]\n- Enables: [list with wikilinks]\n- Affects bounded contexts: [wikilinks to BC pages]\n\n---\n\n[Full content of raw spec, but with:\n - All glossary terms replaced with [[term]] wikilinks\n - All entity mentions wikilinked\n - All cross-spec references wikilinked\n - Frontmatter enriched\n]\n```\n\n### 4. Create Missing Stubs\n\nFor entities/concepts mentioned but lacking wiki page:\n\nCreate stub at `obsidian-vault/wiki/entities/<entity-name>.md` or `concepts/<concept-name>.md`:\n\n```markdown\n---\ntype: entity | concept\nstatus: stub\nmentioned_in: [[spec-where-first-mentioned]]\ncreated: YYYY-MM-DD\ntags: [stub]\n---\n\n# [[Entity/Concept Name]]\n\n> Stub page. Created from mention in [[spec-id]]. Please expand.\n\n## Brief Context\n[From where it was mentioned]\n\n## To Add\n- Full definition\n- Properties\n- Relationships\n- Relevant claims\n\n## Backlinks\n[Obsidian auto-populates]\n```\n\n### 5. Update Index\n\nUpdate `obsidian-vault/wiki/_index.md`:\n\n```markdown\n# Wiki Index\n\n> Catalog of all wiki content. Auto-maintained.\n\n## Specs\n### Tier 2 (Feature)\n- [[specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis]] — Validate Investment Thesis — status: draft — 2026-04-20\n\n## Entities\n- [[entities/vcb]]\n- [[entities/vn30]]\n- ...\n\n## Concepts\n- [[concepts/pump-pattern]]\n- [[concepts/bounded-context]]\n- ...\n\n## Recent Activity\nSee [[_log]]\n```\n\n### 6. Append to Log\n\nAppend to `obsidian-vault/wiki/_log.md`:\n\n```markdown\n## [YYYY-MM-DD] ingest | SPEC-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN\n\n**Type**: spec (tier 2)\n**Source**: `specs/tier2-feature/NNN-feature-name.md`\n**Wiki entry**: `specs/tier2-feature/NNN-feature-name.md`\n**Entities created**: [list]\n**Stubs created**: [list]\n**Links added**: N inbound, M outbound\n```\n\n### 7. Diff-Mode for Updates\n\nIf wiki version already exists (re-run):\n- Diff raw vs previous wiki version\n- Preserve existing wikilinks (don't replace with re-resolution)\n- Add new sections\n- Update metadata\n\nDo not blindly overwrite — may lose human-added connections.\n\n### 8. Output Report\n\n```markdown\n# Spec Converted to Wiki\n\n## Source\n[raw spec path]\n\n## Wiki Version Created\n[wiki path]\n\n## Entities Linked\n- [[term1]] — existing\n- [[term2]] — existing\n- [[term3]] — new stub created\n- ...\n\n## Stubs Created\n- `entities/new-term.md`\n- `concepts/new-concept.md`\n\n## Index Updated\nAdded entry for this spec.\n\n## Log Appended\nSee `wiki/_log.md` latest entry.\n\n## Next Steps\n1. Open Obsidian vault, navigate to new spec\n2. Review linkages in graph view\n3. Expand any stub pages that are important\n4. Connect to related concepts if not auto-linked\n```\n\n---\n\n## Wiki vs Raw — When to Edit Which\n\n**Edit raw spec when**:\n- Content changes\n- Business rules update\n- New decisions made\n- Version bump\n\n**Edit wiki when**:\n- Adding wikilinks agent missed\n- Adding cross-references\n- Enriching with connections found during use\n- Updating status\n\n**Regenerate wiki from raw when**:\n- Raw spec significantly changed\n- Want clean state\n\n---\n\n## Anti-Patterns\n\n**Don't**:\n- Overwrite wiki version without diff check (loses human additions)\n- Create wikilinks to non-existent concepts (create stubs first)\n- Skip frontmatter (breaks Obsidian queries)\n- Duplicate content between raw and wiki (raw is source)\n\n**Do**:\n- Use wikilinks liberally for discoverability\n- Create stubs proactively (better to have empty stub than missing page)\n- Keep frontmatter consistent with schema\n- Update _index.md and _log.md every ingest","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"31a669d5-0e45-4421-a16b-b20e24d04369","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"1691a5a8-8de7-439a-834f-1e05173f2431","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"728f32d3-6592-49db-8a61-4c599cd21118","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_01MhZHLRX195PiG8yFJki6Ky","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01DvM96sHXRtvrxs4V8A4Zic","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\.claude\\commands\\spec-to-wiki.md","content":"# /spec-to-wiki — Convert Raw Spec to Obsidian Wiki Format\n\n> Transform a raw spec into an Obsidian-optimized wiki entry with wikilinks and frontmatter.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- After `/spec-author` creates a spec\n- When a spec changes significantly (regenerate wiki view)\n- When retrofitting an existing spec into the wiki\n\n## Input\n\n`$ARGUMENTS` — path to raw spec file (e.g., `specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis.md`).\n\n## Process\n\nThe full conversion procedure lives in the **`spec-to-wiki` skill** (`.claude/skills/spec-to-wiki/SKILL.md`). Do not duplicate it here. The command's role is to invoke + report.\n\nHigh-level flow:\n\n1. Read raw spec; parse Part A / B / C structure.\n2. Identify entities for linking (glossary terms, other SPEC IDs, BCs, key concepts, tickers, companies).\n3. Resolve each mention against `obsidian-vault/wiki/{entities,concepts}/`. Create stubs for any missing target before linking.\n4. Generate wiki version at `obsidian-vault/wiki/specs/tier<N>-<type>/<NNN>-<slug>.md` with enriched frontmatter (`type`, `tier`, `spec_id`, `status`, `bounded_contexts`, `related_specs`, `ubiquitous_language_terms`, `source` link).\n5. Replace glossary terms with `[[term]]` wikilinks; cross-spec references with `[[SPEC-...]]`; entity mentions with `[[entities/...]]`.\n6. Update `wiki/_index.md` (specs section) + append to `wiki/_log.md` (one line per ingest).\n7. **Diff-mode for re-runs** — if wiki version exists, diff against raw and preserve human-added wikilinks; do NOT blindly overwrite.\n\nFrontmatter shapes for wiki note + stubs are in `.claude/skills/spec-to-wiki/references/` (or, transitively, in `obsidian-vault/wiki/CLAUDE.md`).\n\n## Output Report\n\nAfter conversion, return:\n\n```markdown\n# Spec Converted to Wiki\n\n## Source\n[raw spec path]\n\n## Wiki Version Created\n[wiki path]\n\n## Entities Linked\n- [[term1]] — existing\n- [[term2]] — new stub created\n\n## Stubs Created\n- `entities/new-term.md`\n- `concepts/new-concept.md`\n\n## Index Updated\nAdded entry under `Specs § Tier <N>`.\n\n## Log Appended\nSee `wiki/_log.md` latest entry.\n\n## Next Steps\n1. Open Obsidian, navigate to new spec\n2. Review linkages in graph view\n3. Expand stub pages that are important\n4. Connect related concepts if not auto-linked\n```\n\n## Wiki vs Raw — When to Edit Which\n\n- **Edit raw** when content / business rules / decisions change, or on version bump\n- **Edit wiki** when adding wikilinks the agent missed, cross-references, or status updates\n- **Regenerate wiki from raw** when the raw spec significantly changed and you want a clean state\n\nRaw is the source of truth; wiki is the navigable view.\n\n## Anti-Patterns\n\n**Don't**:\n- Overwrite the wiki version without diff check (loses human additions)\n- Create wikilinks to non-existent concepts (create stubs first)\n- Skip frontmatter (breaks Obsidian Bases queries)\n- Duplicate content between raw and wiki (raw is source)\n- Re-author the conversion procedure here — it lives in the skill\n\n**Do**:\n- Use wikilinks liberally for discoverability\n- Create stubs proactively\n- Keep frontmatter consistent with the schema in `obsidian-vault/wiki/CLAUDE.md`\n- Update `_index.md` + `_log.md` every ingest\n\n## See Also\n\n- `.claude/skills/spec-to-wiki/SKILL.md` — full conversion procedure + diff-mode rules\n- `.claude/skills/obsidian-vault/SKILL.md` — note types + raw/wiki golden rule\n- `obsidian-vault/wiki/CLAUDE.md` — vault-local schema authority\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6966,"cache_read_input_tokens":286820,"output_tokens":2572,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":6966,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":2572,"cache_read_input_tokens":286820,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6966,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":6966},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CaYFkaqwTApdzt9NWhV2f","type":"assistant","uuid":"b89bdeac-9bec-459a-9d83-4aa313ab759f","timestamp":"2026-04-29T14:54:56.993Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"1691a5a8-8de7-439a-834f-1e05173f2431","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

Do not duplicate it here. The command's role is to invoke + report.\n\nHigh-level flow:\n\n1. Read raw spec; parse Part A / B / C structure.\n2. Identify entities for linking (glossary terms, other SPEC IDs, BCs, key concepts, tickers, companies).\n3. Resolve each mention against `obsidian-vault/wiki/{entities,concepts}/`. Create stubs for any missing target before linking.\n4. Generate wiki version at `obsidian-vault/wiki/specs/tier<N>-<type>/<NNN>-<slug>.md` with enriched frontmatter (`type`, `tier`, `spec_id`, `status`, `bounded_contexts`, `related_specs`, `ubiquitous_language_terms`, `source` link).\n5. Replace glossary terms with `[[term]]` wikilinks; cross-spec references with `[[SPEC-...]]`; entity mentions with `[[entities/...]]`.\n6. Update `wiki/_index.md` (specs section) + append to `wiki/_log.md` (one line per ingest).\n7. **Diff-mode for re-runs** — if wiki version exists, diff against raw and preserve human-added wikilinks; do NOT blindly overwrite.\n\nFrontmatter shapes for wiki note + stubs are in `.claude/skills/spec-to-wiki/references/` (or, transitively, in `obsidian-vault/wiki/CLAUDE.md`).\n\n## Output Report\n\nAfter conversion, return:\n\n```markdown\n# Spec Converted to Wiki\n\n## Source\n[raw spec path]\n\n## Wiki Version Created\n[wiki path]\n\n## Entities Linked\n- [[term1]] — existing\n- [[term2]] — new stub created\n\n## Stubs Created\n- `entities/new-term.md`\n- `concepts/new-concept.md`\n\n## Index Updated\nAdded entry under `Specs § Tier <N>`.\n\n## Log Appended\nSee `wiki/_log.md` latest entry.\n\n## Next Steps\n1. Open Obsidian, navigate to new spec\n2. Review linkages in graph view\n3. Expand stub pages that are important\n4. Connect related concepts if not auto-linked\n```\n\n## Wiki vs Raw — When to Edit Which\n\n- **Edit raw** when content / business rules / decisions change, or on version bump\n- **Edit wiki** when adding wikilinks the agent missed, cross-references, or status updates\n- **Regenerate wiki from raw** when the raw spec significantly changed and you want a clean state\n\nRaw is the source of truth; wiki is the navigable view.\n\n## Anti-Patterns\n\n**Don't**:\n- Overwrite the wiki version without diff check (loses human additions)\n- Create wikilinks to non-existent concepts (create stubs first)\n- Skip frontmatter (breaks Obsidian Bases queries)\n- Duplicate content between raw and wiki (raw is source)\n- Re-author the conversion procedure here — it lives in the skill\n\n**Do**:\n- Use wikilinks liberally for discoverability\n- Create stubs proactively\n- Keep frontmatter consistent with the schema in `obsidian-vault/wiki/CLAUDE.md`\n- Update `_index.md` + `_log.md` every ingest\n\n## See Also\n\n- `.claude/skills/spec-to-wiki/SKILL.md` — full conversion procedure + diff-mode rules\n- `.claude/skills/obsidian-vault/SKILL.md` — note types + raw/wiki golden rule\n- `obsidian-vault/wiki/CLAUDE.md` — vault-local schema authority\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":170,"newStart":1,"newLines":38,"lines":[" # /spec-to-wiki — Convert Raw Spec to Obsidian Wiki Format"," ","-> Transform raw spec (source format) to Obsidian-optimized wiki entry with wikilinks and frontmatter.","+> Transform a raw spec into an Obsidian-optimized wiki entry with wikilinks and frontmatter."," "," ## When to Use"," "," - After `/spec-author` creates a spec","-- When spec changes significantly (regenerate wiki view)","-- When retrofitting existing specs into wiki","+- When a spec changes significantly (regenerate wiki view)","+- When retrofitting an existing spec into the wiki"," "," ## Input"," ","-`$ARGUMENTS` — path to raw spec file (e.g., `specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis.md`)","+`$ARGUMENTS` — path to raw spec file (e.g., `specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis.md`)."," "," ## Process"," ","-### 1.
