Read Raw Spec\n\nRead the source spec completely.\nParse structure (Part A / B / C).\n\n### 2. Identify Entities for Linking\n\nScan for:\n- Domain terms from glossary (will become `[[term]]` links)\n- References to other specs (SPEC-YYYY-MM-NNN)\n- Bounded contexts\n- Key concepts\n- Company names, tickers, markets mentioned\n\nFor each mention, determine:\n- Is there existing wiki entry at `obsidian-vault/wiki/entities/` or `obsidian-vault/wiki/concepts/`?\n- If not, create stub page\n\n### 3. Generate Wiki Version\n\nTarget path: `obsidian-vault/wiki/specs/tier2-feature/NNN-feature-name.md`\n\nStructure:\n```markdown\n---\ntype: spec\ntier: 2\nspec_id: SPEC-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN\nstatus: draft | review | approved | implemented | deprecated\nversion: 1.0\ncreated: YYYY-MM-DD\nlast_reviewed: YYYY-MM-DD\nbounded_contexts: [list with [[wiki links]]]\nrelated_specs: [list of spec_ids as wikilinks]\nubiquitous_language_terms: [list with [[wiki links]]]\nsource: [[specs/tier2-feature/NNN-feature-name-raw]]\ntags: [feature, tier2, <domain>]\n---\n\n# [[NNN Feature Name]]\n\n> Wiki view of [[SPEC-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN]]. Raw source: [source file](../../../specs/tier2-feature/NNN-feature-name.md).\n\n## Quick Navigation\n\n- [[#Part A — Business Specification]]\n- [[#Part B — Agent Contract]]\n- [[#Part C — Provenance & Review]]\n\n## Related\n- Depends on: [list with wikilinks]\n- Enables: [list with wikilinks]\n- Affects bounded contexts: [wikilinks to BC pages]\n\n---\n\n[Full content of raw spec, but with:\n - All glossary terms replaced with [[term]] wikilinks\n - All entity mentions wikilinked\n - All cross-spec references wikilinked\n - Frontmatter enriched\n]\n```\n\n### 4. Create Missing Stubs\n\nFor entities/concepts mentioned but lacking wiki page:\n\nCreate stub at `obsidian-vault/wiki/entities/<entity-name>.md` or `concepts/<concept-name>.md`:\n\n```markdown\n---\ntype: entity | concept\nstatus: stub\nmentioned_in: [[spec-where-first-mentioned]]\ncreated: YYYY-MM-DD\ntags: [stub]\n---\n\n# [[Entity/Concept Name]]\n\n> Stub page. Created from mention in [[spec-id]]. Please expand.\n\n## Brief Context\n[From where it was mentioned]\n\n## To Add\n- Full definition\n- Properties\n- Relationships\n- Relevant claims\n\n## Backlinks\n[Obsidian auto-populates]\n```\n\n### 5. Update Index\n\nUpdate `obsidian-vault/wiki/_index.md`:\n\n```markdown\n# Wiki Index\n\n> Catalog of all wiki content. Auto-maintained.\n\n## Specs\n### Tier 2 (Feature)\n- [[specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis]] — Validate Investment Thesis — status: draft — 2026-04-20\n\n## Entities\n- [[entities/vcb]]\n- [[entities/vn30]]\n- ...\n\n## Concepts\n- [[concepts/pump-pattern]]\n- [[concepts/bounded-context]]\n- ...\n\n## Recent Activity\nSee [[_log]]\n```\n\n### 6. Append to Log\n\nAppend to `obsidian-vault/wiki/_log.md`:\n\n```markdown\n## [YYYY-MM-DD] ingest | SPEC-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN\n\n**Type**: spec (tier 2)\n**Source**: `specs/tier2-feature/NNN-feature-name.md`\n**Wiki entry**: `specs/tier2-feature/NNN-feature-name.md`\n**Entities created**: [list]\n**Stubs created**: [list]\n**Links added**: N inbound, M outbound\n```\n\n### 7. Diff-Mode for Updates\n\nIf wiki version already exists (re-run):\n- Diff raw vs previous wiki version\n- Preserve existing wikilinks (don't replace with re-resolution)\n- Add new sections\n- Update metadata\n\nDo not blindly overwrite — may lose human-added connections.\n\n### 8. Output Report\n\n```markdown\n# Spec Converted to Wiki\n\n## Source\n[raw spec path]\n\n## Wiki Version Created\n[wiki path]\n\n## Entities Linked\n- [[term1]] — existing\n- [[term2]] — existing\n- [[term3]] — new stub created\n- ...\n\n## Stubs Created\n- `entities/new-term.md`\n- `concepts/new-concept.md`\n\n## Index Updated\nAdded entry for this spec.\n\n## Log Appended\nSee `wiki/_log.md` latest entry.\n\n## Next Steps\n1. Open Obsidian vault, navigate to new spec\n2. Review linkages in graph view\n3. Expand any stub pages that are important\n4. Connect to related concepts if not auto-linked\n```\n\n---\n\n## Wiki vs Raw — When to Edit Which\n\n**Edit raw spec when**:\n- Content changes\n- Business rules update\n- New decisions made\n- Version bump\n\n**Edit wiki when**:\n- Adding wikilinks agent missed\n- Adding cross-references\n- Enriching with connections found during use\n- Updating status\n\n**Regenerate wiki from raw when**:\n- Raw spec significantly changed\n- Want clean state\n\n---\n\n## Anti-Patterns\n\n**Don't**:\n- Overwrite wiki version without diff check (loses human additions)\n- Create wikilinks to non-existent concepts (create stubs first)\n- Skip frontmatter (breaks Obsidian queries)\n- Duplicate content between raw and wiki (raw is source)\n\n**Do**:\n- Use wikilinks liberally for discoverability\n- Create stubs proactively (better to have empty stub than missing page)\n- Keep frontmatter consistent with schema\n- Update _index.md and _log.md every ingest\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"b89bdeac-9bec-459a-9d83-4aa313ab759f","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"1691a5a8-8de7-439a-834f-1e05173f2431","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"5813f9c4-31ae-4372-b2bc-ecac699740f2","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"skill_listing","content":"- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors (\"from now on when X\", \"each time X\", \"whenever X\", \"before/after X\") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions (\"allow X\", \"add permission\", \"move permission to\"), env vars (\"set X=Y\"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: \"allow npm commands\", \"add bq permission to global settings\", \"move permission to user settings\", \"set DEBUG=true\", \"when claude stops show X\". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.\n- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: \"rebind ctrl+s\", \"add a chord shortcut\", \"change the submit key\", \"customize keybindings\".\n- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.\n- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.\n- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. \"check the deploy every 5 minutes\", \"keep running /babysit-prs\"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.\n- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run (\"run this once at 3pm\", \"remind me to check X tomorrow\").\n- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).\nTRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.\nSKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.\n- ccs-delegation: Auto-activate CCS CLI delegation for deterministic tasks. Parses user input, auto-selects optimal profile (glm/kimi/custom) from ~/.ccs/config.json, enhances prompts with context, executes via `ccs {profile} -p \"task\"` or `ccs {profile}:continue`, and reports results. Triggers on \"use ccs [task]\" patterns, typo/test/refactor keywords. Excludes complex architecture, security-critical code, performance optimization, breaking changes.\n- attach: Port the Claude Code harness layer from this project to a new project directory. Use when bootstrapping a fresh Claude Code project on the same machine, when peers want to copy the harness, or when verifying layer separation via dry-run. Reads .claude/manifest.yaml; copies harness-tagged artifacts only; excludes stockforge biz + personal layers; generates skeleton CLAUDE.md + manifest at target.\n- crawler-reliability: Build reliable web crawlers for data gathering. Use when implementing scrapers for CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz, YouTube (yt-dlp), Facebook fanpages, or any external data source. Covers Python/Playwright patterns, retry/backoff, selector robustness, rate limiting, monitoring.\n- ddd-tactical-patterns: Apply DDD tactical patterns (aggregate, entity, value object, repository, domain event, anti-corruption layer) correctly in Python/dataclasses code. Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\n- decompose-work: Split a non-trivial task into deterministic-vs-LLM portions before execution. Use when planning multi-step work where some sub-tasks are mechanical (file ops, regex, count, schema validation) and others require judgment (synthesis, design, ambiguity resolution). Outputs structured plan that maps each portion to the cheapest competent tool. Pairs with capability-map.md (model × effort × task_class grounding) and try-n-approaches (S9 — Karpathy autoresearch loop).\n- evidence-extraction: Extract structured claims from unstructured sources with citation integrity. Use when building extraction pipelines, parsing news articles or KOL transcripts, or anywhere claims are created from raw data. Ensures every claim has source_url, extracted_at, confidence, and verified attribution. Enforces no-LLM-math invariant (I-S1).\n- fastapi-module: Implement FastAPI routers following StockForge conventions. Use when creating a new HTTP endpoint, adding routes, wiring dependency injection, configuring Pydantic DTOs. Covers router boundaries, provider patterns, testing setup. Phase 2+ only — Phase 1 uses Streamlit dashboard directly.\n- grill-maximization: Doctrine for bundling Q&A questions to the human at maximum density per turn (15-20 target, max 25), so each human-in-the-loop touchpoint is information-rich. Use when composing a Q&A bundle for human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, or when deciding whether to ask one question or wait and bundle. Built on the principle that human-in-the-loop time is the scarcest resource in autonomous coding.\n- obsidian-vault: Search, create, and manage notes in the StockForge Obsidian vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index maintenance. Use when adding content to the knowledge base, navigating entities/concepts, or maintaining the raw/wiki separation. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\n- postgres-pgvector: Design Postgres schemas with pgvector and TimescaleDB for StockForge. Use when creating migrations, designing tables, writing queries. Covers vector embeddings for semantic search on Vietnamese text, time-series for price/sentiment data, JSONB vs structured columns.\n- promote-rule: Cluster agent-notes.md entries by lexical similarity, propose promotion of recurring rules to deterministic hook (priority 1), skill (priority 2), or charter (priority 3). Use when agent-notes has accumulated ≥10 new rules since last promotion run, or on-demand at phase boundary. Outputs proposal markdown to observations/. Pairs with capability-map.md (writes new task_class entries) and decompose-work (consumes promotion outcomes).\n- prompt-engineering: Design and optimize LLM prompts for StockForge pipeline stages. Use when writing or refining prompts for claim extraction, KOL recommendation extraction, sentiment analysis, thesis synthesis. Covers context assembly, prompt caching strategy, budget-aware prompts, structured output. Enforces no-LLM-math constraint.\n- qa-escalation: File-based Q&A protocol — composes bundle file in human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, tracks lifecycle (pending → answered → stale → processed), creates URGENT notification when needed. Use when intent classifier recommends OPEN_QA_BUNDLE / ESCALATE_HUMAN, or grill-maximization has a bundle ready to write. Pairs with grill-maximization (composes content) + Track 5 hooks (auto-move stale).\n- spec-dual-layer: Write specifications with dual-layer structure (business narrative + agent contract). Use when authoring new specs, refining existing specs, or understanding the spec template. Ensures both human stakeholder needs and agent execution needs are served.\n- spec-to-wiki: Convert raw specifications to Obsidian wiki format with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index updates. Use when adding a new spec to the knowledge base, or when regenerating wiki view after spec changes. Maintains raw as source of truth, wiki as navigable view.\n- test-pyramid-balance: Balance unit, integration, and E2E tests properly in Python/pytest. Use when deciding what test to write, reviewing test coverage, or rebalancing skewed test suite. Covers test pyramid shape, BDD vs unit tests, when to use what. Includes stock-domain-specific test categories.\n- try-n-approaches: Karpathy autoresearch outer-loop framing — given a task or signal, generate ≥3 distinct approaches (DEEPEN / BROADEN / ABANDON families), pick one per cheap-first ordering, attach a deterministic metric function (per L-S12-1), and write the experiment frame to learning-data/loop/. Use when an open question surfaces from drift / dogfood / sync-grilling and you need to commit a measurable next step. Pairs with decompose-work (deterministic-vs-LLM split per approach) + capability-map (model × effort grounding) + promote-rule (consumes outcomes).\n- ubiquitous-language: Extract a DDD-style ubiquitous language glossary from the current conversation or domain area. Use when starting work on a new bounded context, when new domain terms emerge, or when verifying consistency between business language and code. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed.\n- user-prompt-intake: Hybrid intent classifier — main session lite-detects trivial prompts, dispatches intent-classifier subagent for complex ones. Use whenever a new user prompt lands (chat or file in human-workspace/user_prompt/) and you need to route the work. Built for full-autonomous loop where every prompt must be classified before action.\n- write-a-skill: Create new Claude Code skills with proper structure, progressive disclosure, and discoverability. Use when extracting a pattern from multiple sessions into a reusable skill, or when user asks to formalize a technique. No new hook needed.\n**Promotion candidate**: amend `write-a-skill/SKILL.md` § Best practices, OR new section in `try-n-approaches/SKILL.md` body; defer to Track 7 (S15) per L-S* batch promotion.\n\n### 2026-04-29 (S14 / Track 6 REWRITE): Skill-vs-Command Duplication Is a Refactor Multiplier\n**Context**: At S14 the `.claude/commands/spec-to-wiki.md` (233 LOC violator) and `.claude/skills/spec-to-wiki/SKILL.md` (227 LOC, separate violator) had ~80% content overlap. [string]$LogFile = \"\"\n)\n\n$ErrorActionPreference = \"Continue\"\n\nif (-not $LogFile) {\n    $ProjectDir = (Get-Item $PSScriptRoot).Parent.Parent.FullName\n    $LogDir = Join-Path $ProjectDir \"agent-workspace\\memory\\handoff-logs\"\n    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $LogDir | Out-Null\n    $LogFile = Join-Path $LogDir (\"continue-injector-{0}.log\" -f (Get-Date -Format \"yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ\"))\n}\nfunction Log($msg) { Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value (\"[{0}] {1}\" -f (Get-Date -Format \"o\"), $msg) }\n\nLog \"start pid=$PID initialDelay=$InitialDelayMs retries=$RetryCount retryDelay=$RetryDelayMs\"\n\nStart-Sleep -Milliseconds $InitialDelayMs\n\nAdd-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms\nAdd-Type @\"\nusing System;\nusing System.Runtime.InteropServices;\npublic class Win32 {\n  [DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern bool SetForegroundWindow(IntPtr hWnd);\n  [DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern bool ShowWindow(IntPtr hWnd, int nCmdShow);\n  [DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern IntPtr GetForegroundWindow();\n  [DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern int GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr hWnd, out int lpdwProcessId);\n}\n\"@\n\nfunction Try-FocusClaudeTerminal {\n    try {\n        $claudes = Get-Process claude -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n        if (-not $claudes) { Log \"no claude.exe running\"; return $false }\n\n        foreach ($c in $claudes) {\n            try {\n                $parentId = (Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"ProcessId = $($c.Id)\" -ErrorAction Stop).ParentProcessId\n                if (-not $parentId) { continue }\n                $parent = Get-Process -Id $parentId -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n                if (-not $parent) { continue }\n                Log (\"claude pid={0} parent={1}({2}) mainWnd=0x{3:X}\" -f $c.Id, $parent.ProcessName, $parent.Id, [int64]$parent.MainWindowHandle)\n                if ($parent.MainWindowHandle -ne [IntPtr]::Zero) {\n                    [Win32]::ShowWindow($parent.MainWindowHandle, 9) | Out-Null\n                    [Win32]::SetForegroundWindow($parent.MainWindowHandle) | Out-Null\n                    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 400\n                    return $true\n                }\n            } catch { Log \"parent-walk error: $_\" }\n        }\n\n        $terminals = @(\"WindowsTerminal\",\"mintty\",\"ConsoleWindowHost\",\"wt\",\"pwsh\",\"powershell\",\"cmd\",\"bash\")\n        foreach ($name in $terminals) {\n            $p = Get-Process $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne [IntPtr]::Zero } | Select-Object -First 1\n            if ($p) {\n                Log (\"fallback focus {0} pid={1}\" -f $name, $p.Id)\n                [Win32]::ShowWindow($p.MainWindowHandle, 9) | Out-Null\n                [Win32]::SetForegroundWindow($p.MainWindowHandle) | Out-Null\n                Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 400\n                return $true\n            }\n        }\n    } catch { Log \"focus error: $_\" }\n    return $false\n}\n\nfunction Send-Continue {\n    try {\n        [System.Windows.Forms.SendKeys]::SendWait(\"continue\")\n        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150\n        [System.Windows.Forms.SendKeys]::SendWait(\"{ENTER}\")\n        return $true\n    } catch { Log \"SendKeys error: $_\"; return $false }\n}\n\n# Idempotency: skip if another injector already fired for this session-ready tick.\n$ProjectDir = (Get-Item $PSScriptRoot).Parent.Parent.FullName\n$SessionTag = (Get-Item (Join-Path $ProjectDir \"agent-workspace\\memory\\.session-ready\") -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).LastWriteTime.Ticks\n$FiredMarker = Join-Path $ProjectDir (\"agent-workspace\\memory\\.continue-fired-{0}\" -f $SessionTag)\nif (Test-Path $FiredMarker) {\n    Log \"already fired for this session-ready tick ($SessionTag); exiting\"\n    exit 0\n}\nSet-Content -Path $FiredMarker -Value (Get-Date -Format \"o\") -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n\nfor ($i = 1; $i -le $RetryCount; $i++) {\n    Log \"attempt $i/$RetryCount\"\n    Try-FocusClaudeTerminal | Out-Null\n    $fg = [Win32]::GetForegroundWindow()\n    [int]$pid_fg = 0\n    [Win32]::GetWindowThreadProcessId($fg, [ref]$pid_fg) | Out-Null\n    $fgProc = Get-Process -Id $pid_fg -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n    Log (\"foreground pid={0} name={1}\" -f $pid_fg, ($fgProc.ProcessName))\n    if (Send-Continue) {\n        Log \"continue+Enter sent (attempt $i)\"\n    } else {\n        Log \"send failed (attempt $i)\"\n    }\n    if ($i -lt $RetryCount) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $RetryDelayMs }\n}\n\nLog \"injector done\"\n","numLines":111,"startLine":1,"totalLines":111}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"91bd9aa4-0a49-4f41-bf83-a9ca70a5dfb2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"1691a5a8-8de7-439a-834f-1e05173f2431","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

auto-recovers via\n# continue-injector.ps1 (Mode-B under wind-down, Mode-C, Mode-D under cliff)\n# or session-self-reboot (Mode-B over wind-down, Mode-D over cliff).\n# Ported from orch v2.2.0 (verbatim with STOCKFORGE_* env rename + ORCH_* fallback).\n# Mode-D = clean-handoff (S14 mid-session add per user \"why not autonomous continue?\").\n# Detects: no A/B/C suspected + checkpoints/latest.md mtime within last 60s + autonomous_mode=true.\n# Pairs the existing failure-mode recovery with end-of-session continuation (clean session boundary).","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# autonomous-stop-watchdog.sh — Stop hook detector for Mode A/B/C loop-break patterns.\n# Logs suspected loop-break to .autonomous-stop-watchdog.log; auto-recovers via\n# continue-injector.ps1 (Mode-B under wind-down, Mode-C) or session-self-reboot (Mode-B over wind-down).\n# Ported from orch v2.2.0 (verbatim with STOCKFORGE_* env rename + ORCH_* fallback).\n\nset -uo pipefail\n\nPROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\nLOG_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory\"\nmkdir -p \"$LOG_DIR\"\nWATCHDOG_LOG=\"$LOG_DIR/.autonomous-stop-watchdog.log\"\nTS=\"$(date -Iseconds 2>/dev/null || date)\"\n\n# 1. Are we in autonomous mode?\nEXEC_FILE=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md\"\nif [[ ! -f \"$EXEC_FILE\" ]]; then exit 0; fi\nif ! grep -qE '^\\*\\*autonomous_mode\\*\\*:\\s*true' \"$EXEC_FILE\" 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi\n\n# 2. Read Stop hook stdin (jq preferred; bash regex fallback for Windows-without-jq).\nSTDIN_JSON=\"$(cat 2>/dev/null || true)\"\nTRANSCRIPT_PATH=\"\"\nSESSION_ID=\"\"\nif [[ -n \"$STDIN_JSON\" ]]; then\n  if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n    TRANSCRIPT_PATH=\"$(printf '%s' \"$STDIN_JSON\" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n    SESSION_ID=\"$(printf '%s' \"$STDIN_JSON\" | jq -r '.session_id // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n  else\n    if [[ \"$STDIN_JSON\" =~ \\\"transcript_path\\\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\\\"([^\\\"]+)\\\" ]]; then\n      TRANSCRIPT_PATH=\"${BASH_REMATCH[1]}\"\n    fi\n    if [[ \"$STDIN_JSON\" =~ \\\"session_id\\\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\\\"([^\\\"]+)\\\" ]]; then\n      SESSION_ID=\"${BASH_REMATCH[1]}\"\n    fi\n  fi\nfi\n\n# 3. Inspect last assistant text for narration-as-action / API error / premature-windown.\nNARRATION_HIT=\"\"\nAPI_ERROR_HIT=\"\"\nAPI_REQUEST_ID=\"\"\nPREMATURE_WINDOWN_HIT=\"\"\nREAL_TRANSCRIPT_TOKENS=\"\"\nWIND_DOWN_MARKER=\"\"\nif [[ -n \"$TRANSCRIPT_PATH\" && -f \"$TRANSCRIPT_PATH\" ]]; then\n  LAST_TAIL=\"$(tail -c 8192 \"$TRANSCRIPT_PATH\" 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n  # Failure mode A: narration verbs WITHOUT tool_use block in same tail.\n  if printf '%s' \"$LAST_TAIL\" | grep -qiE '(Dispatching|Now running|Now dispatching|Will dispatch|Will run|Awaiting (sandwich|task|spec|code|systematic|verifier|reviewer|implementer))' ; then\n    if ! printf '%s' \"$LAST_TAIL\" | grep -qE '\"type\":\"tool_use\"' ; then\n      NARRATION_HIT=\"suspected\"\n    fi\n  fi\n  # Failure mode B: Anthropic API error truncating stream.\n  if printf '%s' \"$LAST_TAIL\" | grep -qE '(overloaded_error|\"type\":\"error\".*\"Overloaded\"|rate_limit_error|api_error|\"status\":5[0-9][0-9])' ; then\n    API_ERROR_HIT=\"suspected\"\n    API_REQUEST_ID=\"$(printf '%s' \"$LAST_TAIL\" | grep -oE '\"request_id\":\"req_[A-Za-z0-9]+\"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*\"\\(req_[A-Za-z0-9]*\\)\".*/\\1/')\"\n  fi\n  # Failure mode C: premature wind-down — wind-down language but real tokens < 200K and no marker.\n  TOKENS_FILE=\"$LOG_DIR/.transcript-tokens\"\n  WIND_DOWN_FILE=\"$LOG_DIR/.wind-down\"\n  if [[ -f \"$TOKENS_FILE\" ]]; then\n    REAL_TRANSCRIPT_TOKENS=\"$(tr -d '[:space:]' < \"$TOKENS_FILE\" 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n  fi\n  if [[ -f \"$WIND_DOWN_FILE\" ]]; then WIND_DOWN_MARKER=\"present\"; fi\n  WIND_DOWN_LANGUAGE=\"\"\n  if printf '%s' \"$LAST_TAIL\" | grep -qiE '(approaching.{0,20}(200K|wind-down|wind down)|past 150K|fresh envelope|fresh budget|writing checkpoint|ending turn cleanly|reboot.{0,30}(envelope|budget|next))' ; then\n    WIND_DOWN_LANGUAGE=\"suspected\"\n  fi\n  if [[ \"$WIND_DOWN_LANGUAGE\" == \"suspected\" && -z \"$WIND_DOWN_MARKER\" && -n \"$REAL_TRANSCRIPT_TOKENS\" ]]; then\n    if [[ \"$REAL_TRANSCRIPT_TOKENS\" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( REAL_TRANSCRIPT_TOKENS < 180000 )); then\n      PREMATURE_WINDOWN_HIT=\"suspected\"\n    fi\n  fi\nfi\n\n# 4. Append structured warning line.\n{\n  printf '[%s] STOP autonomous_mode=true session=%s narration_hit=%s api_error=%s request_id=%s premature_windown=%s real_tokens=%s wind_down_marker=%s transcript=%s\\n' \\\n    \"$TS\" \"${SESSION_ID:-unknown}\" \"${NARRATION_HIT:-clean}\" \"${API_ERROR_HIT:-clean}\" \"${API_REQUEST_ID:-none}\" \"${PREMATURE_WINDOWN_HIT:-clean}\" \"${REAL_TRANSCRIPT_TOKENS:-unknown}\" \"${WIND_DOWN_MARKER:-absent}\" \"${TRANSCRIPT_PATH:-unknown}\"\n} >> \"$WATCHDOG_LOG\"\n\n# 5. auto-recovers via\n# continue-injector.ps1 (Mode-B under wind-down, Mode-C, Mode-D under cliff)\n# or session-self-reboot (Mode-B over wind-down, Mode-D over cliff).\n# Ported from orch v2.2.0 (verbatim with STOCKFORGE_* env rename + ORCH_* fallback).\n# Mode-D = clean-handoff (S14 mid-session add per user \"why not autonomous continue?\").\n# Detects: no A/B/C suspected + checkpoints/latest.md mtime within last 60s + autonomous_mode=true.\n# Pairs the existing failure-mode recovery with end-of-session continuation (clean session boundary).\n\nset -uo pipefail\n\nPROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\nLOG_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory\"\nmkdir -p \"$LOG_DIR\"\nWATCHDOG_LOG=\"$LOG_DIR/.autonomous-stop-watchdog.log\"\nTS=\"$(date -Iseconds 2>/dev/null || date)\"\n\n# 1. Are we in autonomous mode?\nEXEC_FILE=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md\"\nif [[ ! -f \"$EXEC_FILE\" ]]; then exit 0; fi\nif ! grep -qE '^\\*\\*autonomous_mode\\*\\*:\\s*true' \"$EXEC_FILE\" 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi\n\n# 2.
